contentMarkdown: 设区域 D 由直线 $x = -2$，$y = 0$，$y = 2$ 与曲线 $x = -\sqrt{2y - y^{2}}$ 围成，计算二重积分 $\iint_{D} y \, dx \, dy$。
explanationMarkdown:
区域 $D$ 可看作矩形 $[-2,0]\times[0,2]$ 去掉左半圆盘
$$
D_1: x^2+(y-1)^2\le1,\quad x\le0.
$$
因此
$$
I=\iint_D y\,dxdy=\int_{-2}^{0}dx\int_0^2y\,dy-\iint_{D_1}y\,dxdy.
$$
第一项为 $4$。对 $D_1$ 作极坐标平移表示：$x=r\cos\theta,
y=r\sin\theta$ 对应的圆盘部分为 $0\le r\le2\sin\theta,\ \frac\pi2\le\theta\le\pi$。注意面积元为 $r\,dr\,d\theta$，所以
$$
\iint_{D_1}y\,dxdy=\int_{\pi/2}^{\pi}\int_0^{2\sin\theta}(r\sin\theta)r\,dr\,d\theta
=\frac{8}{3}\int_{\pi/2}^{\pi}\sin^4\theta\,d\theta=\frac\pi2.
$$
故
$$
I=4-\frac\pi2.
$$

contentMarkdown: 求二重积分 $\iint_{D}y\left[1+xe^{\frac{1}{2}(x^{2}+y^{2})}\right]dxdy$ 的值，其中 D 是由直线 $y = x$, $y = -1$ 及 $x = 1$ 围成的平面区域。
计算二重积分 $ \iint_{D}x(x+y)dxdy $，其中 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant2,y\geqslant x^{2}\right\} $.
explanationMarkdown:
解 由图(a)可知，区域D关于y轴对称，而xy为关于x的奇函数，故 $ \iint_{D}xy\,dx\,dy=0 $。又因为 $ x^{2} $为关于x的偶函数，所以 
$$
 \iint\limits_{D}x(x+y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint\limits_{D}x^{2}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=2\iint\limits_{D_{1}}x^{2}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y, 
$$
 其中 $ D_{1} $ 是 D 位于右半平面的部分. 我们可以用两种方法来计算 $ \iint_{D_{1}} x^{2} \, dx \, dy $. (法一) 在直角坐标系下计算. 如图(b)所示，先求出圆弧 $ x^{2}+y^{2}=2 $与抛物线 $ y=x^{2} $的交点。由 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}x^{2}+y^{2}&=2,\\ y&=x^{2},\end{aligned}\right. $可求得 $ (x,y)=(1,1) $或 $ (x,y)=(-1,1) $。在第一象限中的交点为 $ (x,y)=(1,1) $。由圆方程 $ x^{2}+y^{2}=2 $可得， $ y=\sqrt{2-x^{2}} $。由于圆弧在第一象限，故根号前取+号。将区域 $ D_{1} $写成X型区域， 
$$
 D_{1}=\left|\left(x,y\right)\right|x^{2}\leqslant y\leqslant\sqrt{2-x^{2}},0\leqslant x\leqslant1\text{)}. 
$$
 从而 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D_{1}}x^{2}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{d}x\int_{x^{2}}^{\sqrt{2-x^{2}}}x^{2}\mathrm{d}y=\int_{0}^{1}x^{2}\left(\sqrt{2-x^{2}}-x^{2}\right)\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int_{0}^{1}x^{2}\sqrt{2-x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x-\int_{0}^{1}x^{4}\mathrm{d}x=\int_{0}^{1}x^{2}\sqrt{2-x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x-\frac{1}{5}\\&\xlongequal{x=\sqrt{2}\sin t}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}4\sin^{2}t\cos^{2}t\mathrm{d}t-\frac{1}{5}=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\left(\sin2t\right)^{2}\mathrm{d}t-\frac{1}{5}\\&=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\frac{1-\cos4t}{2}\mathrm{d}t-\frac{1}{5}=\frac{\pi}{8}-\frac{1}{5}.\end{aligned} 
$$
 因此， 
$$
 \iint\limits_{D}x(x+y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=2\iint\limits_{D_{1}}x^{2}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{2}{5}. 
$$
 (法二) 在极坐标系下计算. 写出 $ x^{2} + y^{2} = 2 $ 的极坐标形式： $ r = \sqrt{2} $. 写出 $ y = x^{2} $ 的极坐标形式： $ r \sin \theta = r^{2} \cos^{2} \theta $，化简为 $ r = \tan \theta \sec \theta $. 可求得圆弧与抛物线的交点坐标为 $ \left(\sqrt{2},\frac{\pi}{4}\right) $。如图(c)所示，连接极点与该交点，将区域 $ D_{1} $分成两部分， $ D_{1}=D_{1}^{\prime}\cup D_{1}^{\prime\prime} $。 $ D_{1}^{\prime} $由 $ \theta=\frac{\pi}{4} $， $ \theta=\frac{\pi}{2} $以及圆弧 $ r=\sqrt{2} $围成； $ D_{1}^{\prime\prime} $由 $ \theta=\frac{\pi}{4} $， $ r=\tan\theta\sec\theta $围成，从而 
$$
 D_{1}^{\prime}=\left\{\left(r,\theta\right)\middle|0\leqslant r\leqslant\sqrt{2},\frac{\pi}{4}\leqslant\theta\leqslant\frac{\pi}{2}\right\},\quad D_{1}^{\prime \prime}=\left\{\left(r,\theta\right)\middle|0\leqslant r\leqslant\tan\theta\sec\theta,0\leqslant\theta\leqslant\frac{\pi}{4}\right\} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{\theta_{1}}x^{2}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{\sqrt{2}}r^{3}\cos^{2}\theta\mathrm{d}r+\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{\tan\theta\sec\theta}r^{3}\cos^{2}\theta\mathrm{d}r\\&=\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{1+\cos2\theta}{2}\mathrm{d}\theta+\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\cos^{2}\theta\cdot\frac{\tan^{4}\theta\sec^{4}\theta}{4}\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=\frac{\pi}{8}-\frac{1}{4}+\frac{1}{4}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\tan^{4}\theta\sec^{2}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta\xlongequal{u=\tan\theta}\frac{\pi}{8}-\frac{1}{4}+\frac{1}{4}\int_{0}^{1}u^{4}\mathrm{d}u\\&=\frac{\pi}{8}-\frac{1}{5}.\end{aligned} 
$$
 因此， 
$$
 \iint\limits_{D}x\left(x+y\right)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=2\iint\limits_{D_{1}}x^{2}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{2}{5}. 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid |x|\leq y\leq1,-1\leq x\leq1\right\} $，则 $ \iint_{D}x^{2}\mathrm{e}^{-y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y= $ ___
explanationMarkdown:
本题主要考查二重积分的计算。本题中的被积函数含有因子 $ e^{-y^{2}} $，计算此类二重积分时，需注意积分次序的选择。解：如图所示，区域 D 是由 y = x，y = -x 以及 y = 1 围成的三角形区域。D 关于 y 轴对称。$ D_{1} $ 为 D 位于右半平面的部分。由于 $ x^{2}e^{-y^{2}} $ 是关于 x 的偶函数，故 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}x^{2}\mathrm{e}^{-y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=2\iint_{D_{1}}x^{2}\mathrm{e}^{-y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=2\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{d}y\int_{0}^{y}x^{2}\mathrm{e}^{-y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x=\frac{2}{3}\int_{0}^{1}y^{3}\mathrm{e}^{-y^{2}}\mathrm{d}y\\&\xlongequal{t=y^{2}}\frac{1}{3}\int_{0}^{1}t\mathrm{e}^{-t}\mathrm{d}t=\frac{1}{3}-\frac{2}{3\mathrm{e}}.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 计算积分 $ \iint_{D}\frac{y^{3}}{\left(1+x^{2}+y^{4}\right)^{2}}dxdy $，其中 D 是第一象限中以曲线 $ y=\sqrt{x} $ 与 x 轴为边界的无界区域。
explanationMarkdown:
本题主要考查反常二重积分的计算。本题中的积分区域为无界区域，在计算时，写出无界区域的表示，将二重积分化为二次积分，最后得到一个反常积分。依照计算反常积分的方法求值即可。解：积分区域 D 为第一象限中，曲线 $ y=\sqrt{x} $ 以下，x 轴以上的无界区域，写成 X 型区域的形式。$ D=\left\{\left(x,y\right)\mid0\leqslant y\leqslant\sqrt{x},0\leqslant x\lt +\infty\right\} $。 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}\frac{y^{3}}{\left(1+x^{2}+y^{4}\right)^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=\int_{0}^{+\infty}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{\sqrt{x}}\frac{y^{3}}{\left(1+x^{2}+y^{4}\right)^{2}}\mathrm{d}y=\frac{1}{4}\int_{0}^{+\infty}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{\sqrt{x}}\frac{\mathrm{d}(y^{4})}{\left(1+x^{2}+y^{4}\right)^{2}}\\&=\frac{1}{4}\int_{0}^{+\infty}\left(-\left.\frac{1}{1+x^{2}+y^{4}}\right|_{0}^{\sqrt{x}}\right)\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\int_{0}^{+\infty}\left(\frac{1}{1+x^{2}}-\frac{1}{1+2x^{2}}\right)\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{4}\left[\arctan x-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\arctan(\sqrt{2}x)\right]\Bigg|_{0}^{+\infty}=\frac{1}{4}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\times\frac{\pi}{2}\right)=\frac{(2-\sqrt{2})\pi}{16}.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设区域 D 由曲线 $ y = \sqrt{3(1 - x^2)} $ 与直线 $ y = \sqrt{3}x $ 及 y 轴围成，计算二重积分 $ \iint_D x^2 \, dx \, dy $。
explanationMarkdown:
令 $x=u,\ y=\sqrt{3}v$，则椭圆弧化为 $u^{2}+v^{2}=1$，直线 $y=\sqrt{3}x$ 化为 $v=u$，$y$ 轴化为 $u=0$。在 $(u,v)$ 平面中区域为 $\frac{\pi}{4}\leqslant\varphi\leqslant\frac{\pi}{2},\ 0\leqslant\rho\leqslant1$，且 $\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\sqrt{3}\,\mathrm{d}u\mathrm{d}v$。因此
$$
\iint_D x^2\,\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\sqrt{3}\int_{\pi/4}^{\pi/2}\int_0^1 \rho^2\cos^2\varphi\cdot\rho\,\mathrm{d}\rho\mathrm{d}\varphi=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}\int_{\pi/4}^{\pi/2}\cos^2\varphi\,\mathrm{d}\varphi=\frac{\sqrt{3}(\pi-2)}{32}.
$$

contentMarkdown: 设平面有界区域 D 位于第一象限，由曲线 $ xy = \frac{1}{3} $，$ xy = 3 $ 与直线 $ y = \frac{1}{3}x $，$ y = 3x $ 围成，计算 $ \iint_{D} (1 + x - y) \, dx \, dy $。
explanationMarkdown:
作变换 $u=xy,\ v=\frac{y}{x}$。区域化为 $\frac13\leqslant u\leqslant3,\ \frac13\leqslant v\leqslant3$，且 $x=\sqrt{\frac{u}{v}},\ y=\sqrt{uv},\ \left|\frac{\partial(x,y)}{\partial(u,v)}\right|=\frac{1}{2v}$。于是
$$
\iint_D(1+x-y)\,\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\int_{1/3}^{3}\int_{1/3}^{3}\left(1+\sqrt{\frac{u}{v}}-\sqrt{uv}\right)\frac{1}{2v}\,\mathrm{d}v\mathrm{d}u.
$$
其中含 $x$ 与含 $y$ 的两项在区间 $[\frac13,3]$ 上积分相等而相消，故原积分为
$$
\int_{1/3}^{3}\int_{1/3}^{3}\frac{1}{2v}\,\mathrm{d}v\mathrm{d}u=\frac{8}{3}\ln3.
$$

contentMarkdown: 求二重积分 $ \iint_{D}x\left[1+yf\left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right)\right]dxdy $ 的值，其中 D 由 $ y=x^{3}, y=1, x=-1 $ 围成。
设积分区域 $D$ 由曲线 $y=\ln x$ 以及直线 $x=2$、$y=0$ 围成，则 $\displaystyle\iint_D\frac{e^{xy}}{x^x-1}\,d\sigma=\underline{\hspace{3em}}$。
explanationMarkdown: 积分区域可表示为$$D=\{(x,y)\mid1\le x\le2,\ 0\le y\le\ln x\}$$因此$$\begin{aligned}I&=\int_1^2\frac1{x^x-1}\left(\int_0^{\ln x}e^{xy}\,dy\right)dx\\&=\int_1^2\frac1{x^x-1}\cdot\frac{e^{x\ln x}-1}{x}\,dx\\&=\int_1^2\frac{x^x-1}{x(x^x-1)}\,dx\\&=\int_1^2\frac{dx}{x}=\ln2\end{aligned}$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant1,x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant2x,y\geqslant0\right\} $，计算 $ I=\iint_{D}xy\,dx\,dy $.
explanationMarkdown:
由 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}x^{2}+y^{2}&=1,\\ x^{2}+y^{2}&=2x\end{aligned}\right. $ 解得交点 $ A\left(\frac{1}{2},\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right) $，积分区域 D 如图 5-18 所示，故 
$$
 \begin{aligned}I=&\iint_{D}x y\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\int_{0}^{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}}\mathrm{d}y\int_{1-\sqrt{1-y^{2}}}^{\sqrt{1-y^{2}}}x y\mathrm{d}x\\ =&\left.\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}}y x^{2}\right|_{\frac{1}{2}-\sqrt{1-y^{2}}}^{\sqrt{1-y^{2}}}\mathrm{d}y\\ =&\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}}y\left[1-y^{2}-(1-\sqrt{1-y^{2}})^{2}\right]\mathrm{d}y\\ =&\int_{0}^{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}}\left(y\sqrt{1-y^{2}}-\frac{1}{2}y\right)\mathrm{d}y\\ =&\left[-\frac{1}{3}(1-y^{2})^{\frac{3}{2}}-\frac{1}{4}y^{2}\right]\bigg|_{0}^{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}}=\frac{5}{48}.\end{aligned} 
$$

解 如图 5-12 所示，设 
$$
 D_{ 大 }=\left\{(x,y)\middle|-2\leqslant x\leqslant0,0\leqslant y\leqslant2\right\}, 
$$
 
$$
 D_{ 小 }=\left\{(x,y)\middle|-\sqrt{2y-y^{2}}\leqslant x\leqslant0\right\}, 
$$
 则 
$$
 \begin{aligned}I=&\iint_{D}y\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint_{D_{ 大 }}y\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y-\iint_{D_{ 小 }}y\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\=&\int_{-2}^{0}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{2}y\mathrm{d}y-\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2\sin\theta}r^{2}\sin\theta\mathrm{d}r\\=&4-\frac{8}{3}\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi}\sin^{4}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta=4-\frac{8}{3}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\cos^{4}t\mathrm{d}t=4-\frac{\pi}{2}.\end{aligned} 
$$
 【注】因 D 关于 y = 1 对称，故 
$$
 I=\iint_{D}y\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint_{D}\left[(y-1)+1\right]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint_{D}(y-1)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint_{D}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=4-\frac{\pi}{2}, 
$$
 或利用形心纵坐标为 $ \overline{y}=1 $，有 $ I=\iint_{D}y\,dx\,dy=\overline{y}\cdot\left(4-\frac{\pi}{2}\right)=4-\frac{\pi}{2} $。

contentMarkdown: 设 D 由 $ x - y = 0 $, $ x + y = 0 $ 及 $ x = 1 $ 所围，求 $ I = \iint_{D} xy(x - y) \, dx \, dy $。
explanationMarkdown:
(Ⅰ)D如图5-14所示，先对y积分较简便。 
$$
 \begin{aligned}I&=\iint_{D}xy\left(x-y\right)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{d}x\int_{-x}^{x}xy\left(x-y\right)\mathrm{d}y\\&=\int_{0}^{1}\left(\frac{x^{2}y^{2}}{2}-\frac{xy^{3}}{3}\right)\bigg|_{-x}^{x}\mathrm{d}x=-\frac{2}{3}\int_{0}^{1}x^{4}\mathrm{d}x=-\frac{2}{15}.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $D$ 由 $y = \sqrt{x}$, $y = x$ 所围，求 $I = \iint_{D} \frac{\sin y}{y} \, dx \, dy$。
设 $D$ 由 $y = x^{2} (x \geqslant 0)$, $y = 1$, $x = 0$ 所围，求 $I = \iint_{D} \frac{xy}{\sqrt{1 + y^{3}}} \, \mathrm{d}x \, \mathrm{d}y$。
explanationMarkdown:
先对 $x$ 积分，则 
$$
 \begin{aligned}I=&\iint_{D}\frac{xy}{\sqrt{1+y^{3}}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\int_{0}^{1}\frac{y}{\sqrt{1+y^{3}}}\mathrm{d}y\int_{0}^{\sqrt{y}}x\mathrm{d}x\\=&\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{1}\frac{y^{2}}{\sqrt{1+y^{3}}}\mathrm{d}y=\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{2}{3}(1+y^{3})^{\frac{1}{2}}\Big|_{0}^{1}=\frac{1}{3}(\sqrt{2}-1).\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $D: -1 \leqslant x \leqslant \sin y, |y| \leqslant \frac{\pi}{2}$，求 $I = \iint_{D} x \left( e^{x^2 + \cos y} \sin y - 1 \right) \, dx \, dy$。
explanationMarkdown: 作辅助线 $y=-\arcsin x(-1\leqslant x\leqslant0)$，将 $D$ 划分为 $D_{1}$ 与 $D_{2}$，则 $I=\iint_{D}x\left(e^{x^{2}+\cos y}\sin y-1\right)d x d y=\iint_{D}x e^{x^{2}+\cos y}\sin y d x d y-\iint_{D}x d x d y\xlongequal{ 记 }I_{1}-I_{2}$。由 $D_{1}$ 关于 $y$ 轴对称，$xe^{x^{2}+\cos y}\sin y$ 关于 $x$ 是奇函数，故 $\iint_{D_{1}}xe^{x^{2}+\cos y}\,dxdy=0$。同理，$\iint_{D_{2}}xe^{x^{2}+\cos y}\sin y\,dxdy=0$，故 $I_{1}=0$。$I_{2}=\iint_{D}x\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint_{D_{1}}x\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint_{D_{2}}x\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$，根据对称性，$\iint_{D_{1}}x\,dx\,dy=0$。又 $\iint_{D_{2}}x\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}y\int_{-1}^{-\sin y}x\mathrm{d}x=-\frac{\pi}{4}$，故 $I = 0 - \left(-\frac{\pi}{4}\right) = \frac{\pi}{4}$。

contentMarkdown: 设平面区域 $D=\left\{(x,y)\mid\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}x\leqslant y\leqslant\sqrt{3}x,1\leqslant x\leqslant2\right\}$，求二重积分 $I=\iint_{D}y\mathrm{e}^{\frac{y}{x}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$。
explanationMarkdown:
方法一 用直角坐标。$I=\int_{1}^{2}\mathrm{d}x\int_{\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}x}^{\sqrt{3}x}y\mathrm{e}^{\frac{y}{x}}\mathrm{d}y$，令 $u=\frac{y}{x}$，得 
$$
\begin{aligned}I&=\int_{1}^{2}\mathrm{d}x\int_{\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}}^{\sqrt{3}}x^{2}u\mathrm{e}^{u}\mathrm{d}u=\int_{1}^{2}x^{2}\mathrm{d}x\int_{\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}}^{\sqrt{3}}u\mathrm{e}^{u}\mathrm{d}u\\&=\frac{7}{3}(u\mathrm{e}^{u}-\mathrm{e}^{u})\Big|_{\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}}^{\sqrt{3}}=\frac{7}{3}\left(\sqrt{3}\mathrm{e}^{\sqrt{3}}-\mathrm{e}^{\sqrt{3}}-\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\mathrm{e}^{\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}}+\mathrm{e}^{\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}}\right)\\&=\frac{7}{3}(\sqrt{3}-1)\left(\mathrm{e}^{\sqrt{3}}+\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\mathrm{e}^{\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}}\right).\end{aligned}
$$
 方法二 用极坐标。$D=\left\{(r,\theta)\left|\frac{1}{\cos\theta}\leqslant r\leqslant\frac{2}{\cos\theta},\frac{\pi}{6}\leqslant\theta\leqslant\frac{\pi}{3}\right.\right\}$，$I=\int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{3}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{\frac{1}{\cos\theta}}^{\frac{2}{\cos\theta}}r\sin\theta\cdot\mathrm{e}^{\tan\theta}r\mathrm{d}r=\frac{1}{3}\int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{3}}\frac{\sin\theta}{\cos^{3}\theta}\cdot(8-1)\cdot\mathrm{e}^{\tan\theta}\mathrm{d}\theta$。令 $u = \tan \theta$，得 
$$
\begin{aligned}I&=\frac{7}{3}\int_{\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}}^{\sqrt{3}}u\mathrm{e}^{u}\mathrm{d}u=\frac{7}{3}(u\mathrm{e}^{u}-\mathrm{e}^{u})\Big|_{\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}}^{\sqrt{3}}=\frac{7}{3}\left(\sqrt{3}\mathrm{e}^{\sqrt{3}}-\mathrm{e}^{\sqrt{3}}-\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\mathrm{e}^{\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}}+\mathrm{e}^{\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}}\right)\\&=\frac{7}{3}(\sqrt{3}-1)\left(\mathrm{e}^{\sqrt{3}}+\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\mathrm{e}^{\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}}\right).\end{aligned}
$$

积分区域 $D=\left\{(x,y)\mid-1\leqslant y\leqslant1,-\frac{\pi}{2}\leqslant x\leqslant\arcsin y\right\}$。交换积分次序，则 
$$
\begin{aligned} 原式 &=\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}x\int_{\sin x}^{1}\mid x\mid y^{2}\mathrm{d}y\\&=\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{\mid x\mid}{3}(1-\sin^{3}x)\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{3}\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mid x\mid\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{2}{3}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}x\mathrm{d}x=\frac{2}{3}\cdot\frac{1}{2}\cdot\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)^{2}=\frac{\pi^{2}}{12}.\end{aligned}
$$

contentMarkdown: 设区域 $D$ 由曲线 $y = x^{3}$ 与直线 $y = x$ 围成，计算积分 $\iint_{D}\left[\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}+\sin(x+y)\right]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$。
explanationMarkdown:
方法1：区域 $D$ 在第一象限部分记为 $D_{1}$，第三象限部分记为 $D_{2}$，根据奇偶性，有
$$
\begin{aligned}\iint_{D}[\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}+\sin(x+y)]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=\iint_{D_{1}}\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint_{D_{2}}\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint_{D_{1}}\sin(x+y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint_{D_{2}}\sin(x+y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&=\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{d}x\int_{x^{3}}^{x}\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}\mathrm{d}y+\int_{-1}^{0}\mathrm{d}x\int_{x^{3}}^{x}\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}\mathrm{d}y+\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{d}x\int_{x^{3}}^{x}\sin(x+y)\mathrm{d}y+\int_{-1}^{0}\mathrm{d}x\int_{x^{3}}^{x}\sin(x+y)\mathrm{d}y\\&=\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}(x-x^{3})\mathrm{d}x+\int_{-1}^{0}\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}(x^{3}-x)\mathrm{d}x-\int_{0}^{1}\cos(x+x)\mathrm{d}x+\int_{0}^{1}\cos(x+x^{3})\mathrm{d}x-\int_{-1}^{0}\cos(x+x^{3})\mathrm{d}x+\int_{-1}^{0}\cos(x+x)\mathrm{d}x\end{aligned}
$$
$$
\begin{aligned}&=2\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}\left(x-x^{3}\right)\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x^{2}-\int_{0}^{1}x^{2}\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x^{2}\\&=\left.\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}\right|_{0}^{1}-\int_{0}^{1}u\mathrm{e}^{u}\mathrm{d}u=\left.\mathrm{e}-1-\left(u\mathrm{e}^{u}-\mathrm{e}^{u}\right)\right|_{0}^{1}=\mathrm{e}-2.\end{aligned}
$$
方法2：利用对称性，$\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}$ 关于原点对称且为偶函数，$\sin(x+y)$ 关于原点对称且为奇函数，因此
$$
\begin{aligned}\iint_{D}[\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}+\sin(x+y)]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=2\iint_{D_{1}}\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=2\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}(x-x^{3})\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x^{2}-\int_{0}^{1}x^{2}\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x^{2}\\&=\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}\left|_{0}^{1}\right.-\int_{0}^{1}u\mathrm{e}^{u}\mathrm{d}u=\left.\mathrm{e}-1-\left(u\mathrm{e}^{u}-\mathrm{e}^{u}\right)\right|_{0}^{1}=\mathrm{e}-2.\end{aligned}
$$

contentMarkdown: 计算二重积分 $I=\iint_{D}y\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$，其中 $D$ 是由 $x$ 轴，$y$ 轴与曲线 $\sqrt{\frac{x}{a}}+\sqrt{\frac{y}{b}}=1$ 所围成的区域，$a\gt0,b\gt0$。
explanationMarkdown:
由 $\sqrt{\frac{x}{a}}+\sqrt{\frac{y}{b}}=1$ 得 $y=b\left(1-\sqrt{\frac{x}{a}}\right)^{2}=b\left(1-\frac{2}{\sqrt{a}}\sqrt{x}+\frac{x}{a}\right)$。
$$
\begin{aligned}\iint_{D}y\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=\int_{0}^{a}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{b\left(1-\sqrt{\frac{x}{a}}\right)^{2}}y\mathrm{d}y\\&=\frac{b^{2}}{2}\int_{0}^{a}\left(\sqrt{\frac{x}{a}}-1\right)^{4}\mathrm{d}x\xlongequal{\sqrt{x}=t}\frac{b^{2}}{2}\int_{0}^{\sqrt{a}}(t-1)^{4}\cdot2at\mathrm{d}t\\&=ab^{2}\int_{0}^{1}(t-1)^{4}\cdot\left[(t-1)+1\right]\mathrm{d}t\\&=ab^{2}\left[\frac{1}{6}(t-1)^{6}\left|_{0}^{1}\right.+\frac{1}{5}(t-1)^{5}\left|_{0}^{1}\right.\right]\\&=ab^{2}\left(\frac{1}{5}-\frac{1}{6}\right)=\frac{ab^{2}}{30}.\end{aligned}
$$
或令 $\sqrt{\frac{x}{a}} = u$，$\sqrt{\frac{y}{b}} = v$，则 $x = au^2$，$y = bv^2$，$\mathrm{d}x = 2au\mathrm{d}u$，$\mathrm{d}y = 2bv\mathrm{d}v$，$D'$ 由 $u$ 轴与 $v$ 轴及 $u + v = 1$ 围成，得
$$
\iint\limits_{D}y\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint\limits_{D^{\prime}}b v^{2}\cdot2au\cdot2b v \mathrm{d}u \mathrm{d}v=4a b^{2}\int_{0}^{1}u \mathrm{d}u\int_{0}^{1-u}v^{3}\mathrm{d}v=a b^{2}\int_{0}^{1}u(1-u)^{4}\mathrm{d}u=\frac{1}{30}a b^{2}
$$

contentMarkdown: (1) 设区域 $D = \{(x, y) \mid \sqrt{|x|} + \sqrt{|y|} \leqslant 1\}$，计算积分 $\iint_{D} (2\sqrt{|x|} + 3\sqrt{|y|}) \, \mathrm{d}x \, \mathrm{d}y$。 (2) (华南理工大学 2010) 设区域 $D$ 由曲线 $\sqrt{\frac{x-c}{a}} + \sqrt{\frac{y-c}{b}} = 1 (a \gt 0, b \gt 0, c \gt 0)$ 与直线 $x = c, y = c$ 围成，计算积分 $\iint_{D} \left( \sqrt{\frac{x-c}{a}} + \sqrt{\frac{y-c}{b}} \right) \, \mathrm{d}x \, \mathrm{d}y$。
explanationMarkdown:
(1) 令 $\sqrt{x}=u,\sqrt{y}=v$，则 $x=u^{2},y=v^{2}$，$\mathrm{d}x=2u\mathrm{d}u$，$\mathrm{d}y=2v\mathrm{d}v$，$D'$ 由 $u$ 轴与 $v$ 轴及 $u+v=1$ 围成，雅可比行列式 $J=4uv$。
$$
\begin{aligned}\iint_{D}(2\sqrt{|x|}+3\sqrt{|y|})\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=4\iint_{D_{1}}(2\sqrt{x}+3\sqrt{y})\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=20\iint_{D_{1}}\sqrt{x}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=80\iint_{D^{\prime}}u^{2}v\mathrm{d}u\mathrm{d}v\\&=80\int_{0}^{1}u^{2}\mathrm{d}u\int_{0}^{1-u}v\mathrm{d}v=40\int_{0}^{1}u^{2}\left(1-u\right)^{2}\mathrm{d}u=\frac{4}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
(2) 令 $\sqrt{\frac{x-c}{a}}=u,\sqrt{\frac{y-c}{b}}=v$，则 $x=au^{2}+c,y=bv^{2}+c,\mathrm{d}x=2au\mathrm{d}u,\mathrm{d}y=2bv\mathrm{d}v$，$D'$ 由 $u$ 轴与 $v$ 轴及 $u+v=1$ 围成。
$$
\begin{align*}\iint_D\left(\sqrt{\frac{x-c}{a}}+\sqrt{\frac{y-c}{b}}\right)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=\iint_D(u+v)4abuv\mathrm{d}u\mathrm{d}v\\&=4ab\int_0^1u\mathrm{d}u\int_0^{1-u}(u+v)v\mathrm{d}v=\frac{2}{15}ab.\end{align*}
$$

contentMarkdown:
设D是由曲线 $ y=x^{3} $ 与直线 $ x=-1 $, $ y=1 $ 所围成的有界闭区域，则 $ \iint_{D}\left[x^{2}+\sin(xy)\right]\mathrm{d}\sigma= $（）.

A. $ \frac{1}{3} $
B. $ \frac{2}{3} $
C. 1
D. $ \frac{4}{3} $
explanationMarkdown:
作曲线 $ y = -x^{3} $，连同 x 轴与 y 轴，将 D 分成 4 块，按逆时针方向，这 4 块分别记为 $ D_{1}, D_{2}, D_{3} $ 与 $ D_{4} $. 
$$
 \iint_{D}[x^{2}+\sin(xy)]\mathrm{d}\sigma=\iint_{D_{1}\cup D_{2}}x^{2}\mathrm{d}\sigma+\iint_{D_{3}\cup D_{4}}x^{2}\mathrm{d}\sigma+\iint_{D_{1}\cup D_{2}}\sin(xy)\mathrm{d}\sigma+\iint_{D_{3}\cup D_{4}}\sin(xy)\mathrm{d}\sigma. 
$$
 
$$
 \iint_{D_{1}\cup D_{2}}x^{2}\mathrm{d}\sigma+\iint_{D_{3}\cup D_{4}}x^{2}\mathrm{d}\sigma=2\iint_{D_{2}}x^{2}\mathrm{d}\sigma+2\iint_{D_{3}}x^{2}\mathrm{d}\sigma=2\iint_{D_{2}\cup D_{3}}x^{2}\mathrm{d}\sigma=2\int_{-1}^{0}x^{2}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{d}y=\frac{2}{3}. 
$$
 由奇偶性，$ \iint_{D_{1}\cup D_{2}}\sin(xy)d\sigma=0,\iint_{D_{3}\cup D_{4}}\sin(xy)d\sigma=0. $ 故原式 $ \frac{2}{3} $.

contentMarkdown: 设 $D$ 是由曲线 $\left\{\begin{aligned} x &= 1 - \cos t, \\ y &= t - \sin t \end{aligned}\right.$ $(0 \leqslant t \leqslant 2\pi)$ 与 $y$ 轴所围平面区域，计算 $I = \iint_{D} (2x + y) \, \mathrm{d}x \, \mathrm{d}y$。
explanationMarkdown:
积分区域 $D$ 如图 5-47 所示，在直角坐标下，$D = \{(x, y) \mid 0 \leqslant y \leqslant 2\pi, 0 \leqslant x \leqslant x(y)\}$，这里 $x = x(y)$ 由参数方程 $\left\{\begin{aligned} x &= 1 - \cos t, \\ y &= t - \sin t \end{aligned}\right.$ 确定。
$$
 I=\iint\limits_{D}(2x+y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint\limits_{D}2x\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint\limits_{D}y\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y. 
$$
又
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}2x\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=\int_{0}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}y\int_{0}^{x(y)}2x\mathrm{d}x=\int_{0}^{2\pi}x^{2}(y)\mathrm{d}y\\&=\int_{0}^{2\pi}\left\{x\left[y(t)\right]\right\}^{2}\cdot y^{\prime}(t)\mathrm{d}t=\int_{0}^{2\pi}\left[x(t)\right]^{2}\cdot y^{\prime}(t)\mathrm{d}t\\&\xlongequal{x=1-\cos t}\int_{0}^{2\pi}\left(1-\cos t\right)^{2}\cdot(1-\cos t)\mathrm{d}t\\&=\int_{0}^{2\pi}(1-\cos t)^{3}\mathrm{d}t=\int_{0}^{2\pi}\left(2\sin^{2}\frac{t}{2}\right)^{3}\mathrm{d}t\\&=8\int_{0}^{2\pi}\sin^{6}\frac{t}{2}\mathrm{d}t\xlongequal{\frac{t}{2}=u}16\int_{0}^{\pi}\sin^{6}u\mathrm{d}u\\&=16\cdot2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sin^{6}u\mathrm{d}u=32\times\frac{5}{6}\times\frac{3}{4}\times\frac{1}{2}\times\frac{\pi}{2}=5\pi,\end{aligned} 
$$
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}y\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=\int_{0}^{2\pi}y\mathrm{d}y\int_{0}^{x(y)}\mathrm{d}x=\int_{0}^{2\pi}y\cdot x(y)\mathrm{d}y\\&=\int_{0}^{2\pi}y(t)\cdot x(t)\cdot y^{\prime}(t)\mathrm{d}t\\&\xlongequal[y=t-\sin t]{x=1-\cos t}\int_{0}^{2\pi}(t-\sin t)(1-\cos t)^{2}\mathrm{d}t\\&\xlongequal{t=u+\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}(u+\pi+\sin u)(1+\cos u)^{2}\mathrm{d}u\\&=\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}(u+\sin u)(1+\cos u)^{2}\mathrm{d}u+\pi\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}(1+\cos u)^{2}\mathrm{d}u\\&=0+\pi\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}(1+\cos u)^{2}\mathrm{d}u( \text{利用奇函数} )\\&=2\pi\int_{0}^{\pi}(1+\cos u)^{2}\mathrm{d}u=8\pi\int_{0}^{\pi}\cos^{4}\frac{u}{2}\mathrm{d}u\\&\xlongequal{u=2s}16\pi\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\cos^{4}s\mathrm{d}s=16\pi\times\frac{3}{4}\times\frac{1}{2}\times\frac{\pi}{2}=3\pi^{2},\end{aligned} 
$$
故 $I = 5\pi + 3\pi^{2}$。
【注】由于 $D$ 关于直线 $y=\pi$ 对称，故区域 $D$ 的形心位于 $y=\pi$ 上，即形心的纵坐标 $\overline{y}=\pi$。由形心公式，知 $\overline{y}=\frac{\iint_{D}y\,dx\,dy}{\iint_{D}dx\,dy}$，则
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}y\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=\overline{y}\bullet\iint_{D}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\pi\iint_{D}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\pi\int_{0}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}y\int_{0}^{x(y)}\mathrm{d}x=\pi\int_{0}^{2\pi}x(y)\mathrm{d}y\\&=\pi\int_{0}^{2\pi}x(t)\bullet y^{\prime}(t)\mathrm{d}t=\pi\int_{0}^{2\pi}(1-\cos t)\bullet(1-\cos t)\mathrm{d}t\\&=\pi\int_{0}^{2\pi}(1-\cos t)^{2}\mathrm{d}t=4\pi\int_{0}^{2\pi}\sin^{4}\frac{t}{2}\mathrm{d}t\xlongequal{\frac{t}{2}=u}8\pi\int_{0}^{\pi}\sin^{4}u\mathrm{d}u\\&=16\pi\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sin^{4}u\mathrm{d}u=16\pi\times\frac{3}{4}\times\frac{1}{2}\times\frac{\pi}{2}=3\pi^{2}.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设区域 $D$ 由曲线 $\left\{\begin{aligned} x &= a(t - \sin t), \\ y &= a(1 - \cos t) \end{aligned}\right.$ $(t \in [0, 2\pi])$ 与 $x$ 轴围成，计算积分 $\iint_{D} y^{2} \, dx \, dy$。
explanationMarkdown:
$$
 \iint_{D}y^{2}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\int_{0}^{2\pi a}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{y(x)}y^{2}\mathrm{d}y=\frac{1}{3}\int_{0}^{2\pi a}y^{3}(x)\mathrm{d}x 
$$
换元令 $x=a(t-\sin t)$，$y(x(t))=a(1-\cos t)$。
$$
 \begin{aligned}&=\frac{1}{3}\int_{0}^{2\pi}a^{3}\left(1-\cos t\right)^{3}a\left(1-\cos t\right)\mathrm{d}t\\&=\frac{16a^{4}}{3}\int_{0}^{2\pi}\sin^{8}\frac{t}{2}\mathrm{d}t\xlongequal{ \text{令 } \frac{t}{2}=u}\frac{32a^{4}}{3}\int_{0}^{\pi}\sin^{8}u\mathrm{d}u=\frac{64a^{4}}{3}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sin^{8}u\mathrm{d}u\\&=\frac{64a^{4}}{3}\cdot\frac{7}{8}\cdot\frac{5}{6}\cdot\frac{3}{4}\cdot\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{\pi}{2}=\frac{35}{12}\pi a^{4}.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D=\left\{(\theta,r)\mid0\leqslant\theta\leqslant\frac{\pi}{2},0\leqslant r\leqslant1\right\} $，计算 $ I=\iint_{D}r^{3}e^{r^{2}\cos2\theta}\sin2\theta d\theta dr $.
explanationMarkdown:
方法一: 转化为直角坐标，积分区域 D 如图 5-38 所示。
$$
 \begin{aligned}I=&\iint_{D}^{}2r\cos\theta r\sin\theta\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}(\cos^{2}\theta-\sin^{2}\theta)}r\mathrm{d}\theta\mathrm{d}r\\=&2\iint_{D}^{}x y\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}-y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\=&2\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{e}^{x}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}\mathrm{e}^{y\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}-y^{2}}}\mathrm{d}y\\=&2\bullet\frac{-1}{2}\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{e}x\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}-y^{2}}\mathrm{d}(x^{2}-y^{2})\\=&-\int_{0}^{1}x\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}-y^{2}}\left|\begin{matrix}\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\\ 0\end{matrix}\right.\mathrm{d}x=-\int_{0}^{1}x\left(\mathrm{e}^{2x^{2}-1}-\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}\right)\mathrm{d}x\\=&-\frac{1}{4}\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{e}^{2x^{2}-1}\mathrm{d}(2x^{2}-1)+\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}\mathrm{d}(x^{2})\\=&-\frac{1}{4}\mathrm{e}^{2x^{2}-1}\left|\begin{matrix}1\\ 0\end{matrix}\right.+\frac{1}{2}\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}}\left|\begin{matrix}1\\ 0\end{matrix}\right.=\frac{1}{4}(\mathrm{e}+\mathrm{e}^{-1})-\frac{1}{2}.\end{aligned} 
$$
 
方法二：在极坐标下，选择先对 $ \theta $ 积分后对 r 积分。
$$
 \begin{aligned}I&=\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{d}r\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}r^{3}\mathrm{e}^{r^{2}\cos2\theta}\sin2\theta\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=-\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{1}r\mathrm{d}r\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\left(\mathrm{e}^{r^{2}\cos2\theta}\right)=-\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{1}r\left(\mathrm{e}^{r^{2}\cos2\theta}\right)\bigg|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}r\\&=-\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{1}r\left(\mathrm{e}^{-r^{2}}-\mathrm{e}^{r^{2}}\right)\mathrm{d}r=-\frac{1}{4}\int_{0}^{1}\left(\mathrm{e}^{-r^{2}}-\mathrm{e}^{r^{2}}\right)\mathrm{d}r^{2}\\&\xlongequal{r^{2}=t}-\frac{1}{4}\int_{0}^{1}\left(\mathrm{e}^{-r}-\mathrm{e}^{t}\right)\mathrm{d}t=-\frac{1}{4}\left(-\mathrm{e}^{-t}\bigg|_{0}^{1}-\mathrm{e}^{t}\bigg|_{0}^{1}\right)\\&=\frac{1}{4}(\mathrm{e}^{-1}+\mathrm{e})-\frac{1}{2}.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设平面区域 $D=\{(r,\theta)\mid r\le1,\ r\le2\cos\theta,\ \sin\theta\ge0\}$，计算 $\iint_D r^2\left(\cos\theta+\frac12r\sin2\theta\right)\mathrm{d}r\,\mathrm{d}\theta$。
explanationMarkdown:
由区域条件可得：当 $0\le\theta\le\frac{\pi}{3}$ 时，$0\le r\le1$；当 $\frac{\pi}{3}\le\theta\le\frac{\pi}{2}$ 时，$0\le r\le2\cos\theta$。因此
$$
\begin{aligned}I={}&\int_0^{\pi/3}\int_0^1r^2\left(\cos\theta+\frac12r\sin2\theta\right)dr\,d\theta\\&+\int_{\pi/3}^{\pi/2}\int_0^{2\cos\theta}r^2\left(\cos\theta+\frac12r\sin2\theta\right)dr\,d\theta\\={}&\frac{\pi}{6}-\frac{\sqrt3}{8}+\frac5{48}.\end{aligned}
$$

contentMarkdown:
设平面区域
$$
D=
\left\{(r,\theta)\ \middle|\
\begin{array}{ll}
0\le\theta\le\arctan\pi,&0\le r\le\dfrac1{\cos\theta},\\[4pt]
\arctan\pi\le\theta\le\dfrac\pi2,&0\le r\le\dfrac\pi{\sin\theta}
\end{array}
\right\},
$$
则
$$
\iint_D\left|r^2\cos\theta-r\sin^2(r\sin\theta)\right|\,dr\,d\theta
=\underline{\hspace{4em}}.
$$
explanationMarkdown:
令
$$
x=r\cos\theta,\qquad y=r\sin\theta.
$$
边界
$$
r=\frac1{\cos\theta},\qquad r=\frac\pi{\sin\theta}
$$
分别对应直线
$$
x=1,\qquad y=\pi.
$$
因此区域 $D$ 在直角坐标系下为
$$
0\le x\le1,\qquad 0\le y\le\pi.
$$
又因为
$$
dx\,dy=r\,dr\,d\theta,
$$
所以
$$
\iint_D\left|r^2\cos\theta-r\sin^2(r\sin\theta)\right|\,dr\,d\theta
=
\int_0^\pi\int_0^1|x-\sin^2y|\,dx\,dy.
$$
固定 $y$，令
$$
a=\sin^2y.
$$
由于 $0\le a\le1$，
$$
\begin{aligned}
\int_0^1|x-a|\,dx
&=\int_0^a(a-x)\,dx+\int_a^1(x-a)\,dx\\
&=\frac12-a+a^2.
\end{aligned}
$$
于是
$$
\begin{aligned}
\int_0^\pi\left(\frac12-\sin^2y+\sin^4y\right)dy
&=\frac\pi2-\frac\pi2+\frac{3\pi}{8}\\
&=\frac{3\pi}{8}.
\end{aligned}
$$
故应填
$$
\boxed{\frac{3\pi}{8}}.
$$

contentMarkdown: 计算二重积分 $ I = \iint_{D} \frac{r^{3} \sin 2\theta}{\sqrt{1 + r^{2} \cos^{2}\theta - 4r^{2} \sin^{2}\theta}} \mathrm{d}r \mathrm{d}\theta $，其中 $ D=\left\{(r,\theta)\middle|\sec\theta\leqslant r\leqslant2\sec\theta,0\leqslant\theta\leqslant\arctan\frac{1}{2}\right\}. $
explanationMarkdown:
在极坐标系下，积分区域 $ D = \left\{(r, \theta) \mid \sec \theta \leqslant r \leqslant 2\sec \theta, 0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant \arctan \frac{1}{2}\right\} $. 由 $ \sec \theta \leqslant r \leqslant 2\sec \theta $ 得， $ 1 \leqslant r \cos \theta \leqslant 2 $. 又由于 $ 0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant \arctan \frac{1}{2} $，故可知在直角坐标系下，D 为由 x = 1，x = 2，y = $ \frac{1}{2}x $ 以及 x 轴围成的梯形区域. 将 D 写成 X 型区域: $ D=\Big\{\left(x,y\right)\mid0\leqslant y\leqslant\frac{1}{2}x,1\leqslant x\leqslant2\Big\}. $ 由 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}x&=r\cos\theta,\\ y&=r\sin\theta\end{aligned}\right. $，以及 $ \sin2\theta=2\sin\theta\cos\theta $可得 $ \frac{r^{3}\sin2\theta}{\sqrt{1+r^{2}\cos^{2}\theta-4r^{2}\sin^{2}\theta}}=\frac{2r^{3}\sin\theta\cos\theta}{\sqrt{1+r^{2}\cos^{2}\theta-4r^{2}\sin^{2}\theta}}=\frac{2r x y}{\sqrt{1+x^{2}-4y^{2}}}. $ 结合 $ dxdy = rdrd\theta, I $ 在直角坐标系下为 $ I=\iint\limits_{D}\frac{2xy}{\sqrt{1+x^{2}-4y^{2}}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y. $ 因此， 
$$
 \begin{aligned}I&=\iint_{D}\frac{2xy}{\sqrt{1+x^{2}-4y^{2}}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=2\int_{1}^{2}x\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}x}\frac{y}{\sqrt{1-(4y^{2}-x^{2})}}\mathrm{d}y\\&=\frac{1}{4}\int_{1}^{2}x\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}x}\frac{\mathrm{d}(4y^{2}-x^{2})}{\sqrt{1-(4y^{2}-x^{2})}}=-\left.\frac{1}{2}\int_{1}^{2}x\cdot\sqrt{1-(4y^{2}-x^{2})}\right|_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}x}\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{2}\int_{1}^{2}(x\sqrt{1+x^{2}}-x)\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\int_{1}^{2}\sqrt{1+x^{2}}\mathrm{d}(x^{2})-\frac{1}{2}\int_{1}^{2}x\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{4}\cdot\frac{2}{3}\left(1+x^{2}\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}\bigg|_{1}^{2}-\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{x^{2}}{2}\bigg|_{1}^{2}=\frac{5\sqrt{5}-2\sqrt{2}}{6}-\frac{3}{4}.\end{aligned} 
$$
sourceText: 900 第五章数二 B 类 19

contentMarkdown: 设区域 $ D = \left\{(r, \theta) \mid 0 \leqslant r \leqslant \pi \sec \theta, 0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant \frac{\pi}{4}\right\} $，计算 $ I=\iint\limits_{D}^{}r^{2}\cos\theta\cos\left[\sqrt{2}r\sin\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)\right]\mathrm{d}r\mathrm{d}\theta. $
explanationMarkdown:
由 $ 0 \leqslant r \leqslant \pi \sec \theta $ 得， $ 0 \leqslant r \cos \theta \leqslant \pi $，即 $ 0 \leqslant x \leqslant \pi $。又由于 $ 0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant \frac{\pi}{4} $，故在直角坐标系下，D 为由直线 $ x = \pi, y = x $ 以及 x 轴围成的三角形区域。将 D 写成 X 型区域: $ D=\left\{\left(x,y\right)\mid0\leqslant y\leqslant x,0\leqslant x\leqslant\pi\right\}. $ 因此， 
$$
 \begin{aligned}I&=\iint_{D}^{}r^{2}\cos\theta\cos\left[\sqrt{2}r\left(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\sin\theta+\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\cos\theta\right)\right]dr\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=\iint_{D}^{}r^{2}\cos\theta\cos\left(r\cos\theta+r\sin\theta\right)dr\mathrm{d}\theta=\iint_{D}^{}x\cos(x+y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&=\int_{0}^{\pi}x\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{x}\cos(x+y)\mathrm{d}y=\int_{0}^{\pi}x\sin(x+y)\left.\right|_{y=0}^{y=x}\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int_{0}^{\pi}x(\sin2x-\sin x)\mathrm{d}x=-\left.\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{\pi}x\mathrm{d}(\cos2x)\right.+\int_{0}^{\pi}x\mathrm{d}(\cos x)\\&=-\left.\frac{1}{2}\left(x\cos2x\left.\right|_{0}^{\pi}-\int_{0}^{\pi}\cos2x\mathrm{d}x\right)+\left(x\cos x\left.\right|_{0}^{\pi}-\int_{0}^{\pi}\cos x\mathrm{d}x\right)\right.\\&=-\left.\frac{\pi}{2}-\pi=-\frac{3}{2}\pi.\right.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 1) $\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{1}\frac{(1+\sqrt{r\cos\theta})r}{2+\sqrt{r\sin\theta}+\sqrt{r\cos\theta}}\mathrm{d}r$; 2) $\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{3}{4}\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2\sin\theta}(\sin\theta+\cos\theta\sqrt{1+r^{2}\sin^{2}\theta})r^{2}\mathrm{d}r.$
explanationMarkdown:
（1）令 $x=r\cos\theta,\ y=r\sin\theta$。积分区域为第一象限单位圆扇形，且被积函数为 $\frac{1+\sqrt{x}}{2+\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{y}}$。关于 $x,y$ 对称取平均，得
$$
I_1=\frac12\iint_D\frac{2+\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{y}}{2+\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{y}}\,\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\frac12\cdot\frac{\pi}{4}=\frac{\pi}{8}.
$$
（2）极坐标区域对应 $x^2+y^2\leqslant2y$ 且 $y\geqslant |x|$。奇偶性使含 $x\sqrt{1+y^2}$ 的部分相消，只需算 $2\iint_{D_1}y\,\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$，其中 $D_1:0\leqslant x\leqslant1,\ x\leqslant y\leqslant1+\sqrt{1-x^2}$。故
$$
I_2=2\int_0^1\int_x^{1+\sqrt{1-x^2}}y\,\mathrm{d}y\mathrm{d}x=\frac{4}{3}+\frac{\pi}{2}.
$$

contentMarkdown: 设区域 $D$ 为 $x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant R^{2}$，则 $\iint_{D}\left(\frac{x^{2}}{a^{2}}+\frac{y^{2}}{b^{2}}\right)dxdy=$
explanationMarkdown: 由对称性得 $\iint_{D}x^{2}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint_{D}y^{2}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\frac{1}{2}\iint_{D}(x^{2}+y^{2})\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{R}r^{3}\mathrm{d}r=\frac{\pi R^{4}}{4}$，故 $\iint_{D}\left(\frac{x^{2}}{a^{2}}+\frac{y^{2}}{b^{2}}\right)dx dy=\frac{1}{a^{2}}\iint_{D}x^{2}dx dy+\frac{1}{b^{2}}\iint_{D}y^{2}dx dy=\left(\frac{1}{a^{2}}+\frac{1}{b^{2}}\right)\cdot\frac{\pi R^{4}}{4}=\frac{\pi R^{4}}{4}\left(\frac{1}{a^{2}}+\frac{1}{b^{2}}\right)$。

contentMarkdown: 设 $D: x^{2} + y^{2} \leqslant 1$，则 $I = \iint_{D} \left( \frac{x^{2}}{4} + \frac{y^{2}}{9} \right) \, dx \, dy =$ ___

contentMarkdown: 设有界区域 $D$ 是圆 $x^{2} + y^{2} = 1$ 和直线 $y = x$ 以及 $x$ 轴在第一象限围成的部分，计算二重积分 $\iint_{D} e^{(x+y)^{2}}(x^{2} - y^{2}) \, dx \, dy$.
explanationMarkdown:
【详解一】利用极坐标变换。区域 $D$ 为 $0\le\theta\le\frac{\pi}{4}$，$0\le r\le1$。原积分等于 
$$
\int_0^{\pi/4}\int_0^1 e^{r^2(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)^2}r^2(\cos^2\theta-\sin^2\theta)r\,dr\,d\theta.
$$
 对 $\theta$ 积分时令 $u=r^2(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)^2$，则 $du=2r^2(\cos^2\theta-\sin^2\theta)d\theta$，故原式 
$$
=\frac{1}{2}\int_0^1 r\left(e^{2r^2}-e^{r^2}\right)dr=\frac{(e-1)^2}{8}.
$$
 【详解二】令 $u=x+y$，$v=x-y$，则 $|J|=\frac{1}{2}$，积分化为 $\frac{1}{2}\iint_{D'}e^{u^2}uv\,du\,dv$，继续计算同样得到 $\frac{(e-1)^2}{8}$。

contentMarkdown: 设 $D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leq1,y\geq0\right\}$，连续函数 $f(x,y)$ 满足 $f(x,y)=y\sqrt{1-x^{2}}+x\iint_{D}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$，求 $\iint_{D}xf(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$。
explanationMarkdown:
解：记 $A = \iint_{D} f(x, y) \, dx \, dy$。
等式 $f(x,y)=y\sqrt{1-x^{2}}+x\iint_{D}f(x,y)dxdy$ 两端在 $D$ 上积分，可得
$$
A=\iint\limits_{D}y\ \sqrt{1-x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+A\iint\limits_{D}x\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y.
$$
区域 $D$ 为位于 $x$ 轴上方的半圆盘，关于 $y$ 轴对称。又因为 $x$ 为关于 $x$ 的奇函数，所以 $\iint_{D}x\,dx\,dy=0$。
将 $D$ 写成 $X$ 型区域：$D = \left\{(x, y) \mid 0 \leqslant y \leqslant \sqrt{1 - x^{2}}, -1 \leqslant x \leqslant 1\right\}$。于是，
$$
\begin{aligned}A&=\iint_{D}y\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\int_{-1}^{1}\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}y\mathrm{d}y=\int_{-1}^{1}\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\cdot\frac{1-x^{2}}{2}\mathrm{d}x\\&\xlongequal{对称性}\int_{0}^{1}\left(1-x^{2}\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}\mathrm{d}x\xlongequal{x=\sin t}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\cos^{3}t\cdot\cos t\mathrm{d}t\\&=\frac{3}{4}\times\frac{1}{2}\times\frac{\pi}{2}=\frac{3}{16}\pi.\end{aligned}
$$
因此，$f(x,y)=y\sqrt{1-x^{2}}+\frac{3\pi}{16}x$。
$$
\begin{aligned}\iint_{D}x f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=\iint_{D}\left(x y\sqrt{1-x^{2}}+\frac{3\pi}{16}x^{2}\right)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\xlongequal{对称性}\frac{3\pi}{16}\iint_{D}x^{2}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&\xlongequal{极坐标}\frac{3\pi}{16}\int_{0}^{\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{1}r^{2}\cos^{2}\theta\cdot r\mathrm{d}r=\frac{3\pi}{16}\int_{0}^{\pi}\cos^{2}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{1}r^{3}\mathrm{d}r\\&=\frac{3\pi}{16}\cdot2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\cos^{2}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta\cdot\frac{1}{4}=\frac{3\pi}{16}\times2\times\frac{1}{2}\times\frac{\pi}{2}\times\frac{1}{4}\\&=\frac{3\pi^{2}}{128}.\end{aligned}
$$

contentMarkdown: 设积分区域 $D = \{(x, y) \mid 1 \leqslant x^{2} + y^{2} \leqslant e^{2}\}$，则 $\iint_{D} x^{2} \ln(x^{2} + y^{2}) \, \mathrm{d}\sigma = $ ___。
explanationMarkdown:
解：利用极坐标和轮换对称性。
$$
\begin{aligned}I&=\frac{1}{2}\iint_{D}(x^{2} + y^{2})\ln(x^{2} + y^{2})d\sigma\\&=\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{2\pi}d\theta\int_{1}^{e}r^{2}\ln r^{2}\cdot rdr\\&=2\pi\int_{1}^{e}r^{3}\ln rdr\\&=\frac{\pi}{2}\int_{1}^{e}\ln rdr^{4}\\&=\frac{\pi}{2}r^{4}\ln r\Big|_{1}^{e}-\frac{\pi}{2}\int_{1}^{e}r^{3}dr\\&=\frac{\pi}{2}e^{4}-\frac{\pi}{8}(e^{4}-1)\\&=\frac{3}{8}\pi e^{4}+\frac{\pi}{8}\end{aligned}
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $D=\left\{(x,y)\mid1-|x|\leqslant y\leqslant\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\right\}$，求二重积分 $\iint_{D}\frac{x^{3}+y^{3}}{\left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right)^{3}}dxdy$。
explanationMarkdown:
【解析】利用极坐标计算。根据对称性，得
$$
\begin{aligned} 原式 &=2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{\frac{1}{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}}^{1}\frac{r^{3}\sin^{3}\theta}{r^{6}}r\mathrm{d}r=2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sin^{3}\theta(\cos\theta+\sin\theta-1)\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(\sin^{3}\theta\cos\theta+\sin^{4}\theta-\sin^{3}\theta)\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=2\Big(\frac{1}{4}+\frac{3\pi}{16}-\frac{2}{3}\Big)=\frac{3\pi}{8}-\frac{5}{6}.\end{aligned}
$$

contentMarkdown: 已知平面区域 $D=\left\{(x,y)\mid\sqrt{1-y^{2}}\leq x\leq1,-1\leq y\leq1\right\}$，计算 $\iint_{D}\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}dxdy$。
explanationMarkdown:
由区域关于 $x$ 轴对称，且被积函数关于 $y$ 为偶函数，记 $D_1=D\cap\{y\geq0\}$，则
$$
I=2\iint_{D_1}\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}}\,dx\,dy.
$$

方法一（直角坐标）：
$$
\begin{aligned}
\iint_{D_1}\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}}\,dx\,dy
&=\int_0^1dy\int_{\sqrt{1-y^2}}^1\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}}\,dx\\
&=\int_0^1\left(\sqrt{1+y^2}-1\right)dy\\
&=\frac12\left[\ln(1+\sqrt2)+\sqrt2\right]-1.
\end{aligned}
$$
因此
$$
I=\ln(1+\sqrt2)+\sqrt2-2.
$$

方法二（极坐标）：
将 $D_1$ 分为
$$
D_{11}:\ 0\leq\theta\leq\frac{\pi}{4},\quad 1\leq r\leq\frac1{\cos\theta},
$$
以及
$$
D_{12}:\ \frac{\pi}{4}\leq\theta\leq\frac{\pi}{2},\quad 1\leq r\leq\frac1{\sin\theta}.
$$
区域 $D_{11}$ 与 $D_{12}$ 关于直线 $y=x$ 对称，故
$$
\begin{aligned}
\iint_{D_1}\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}}\,dx\,dy
&=\iint_{D_{11}}\frac{x+y}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}}\,dx\,dy\\
&=\int_0^{\pi/4}d\theta\int_1^{1/\cos\theta}(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)r\,dr\\
&=\frac12\left[\ln(\sec\theta+\tan\theta)-\sin\theta+\sec\theta+\cos\theta\right]_0^{\pi/4}\\
&=\frac12\left[\ln(1+\sqrt2)+\sqrt2-2\right].
\end{aligned}
$$
所以
$$
I=\ln(1+\sqrt2)+\sqrt2-2.
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D:\frac{x^{2}}{a^{2}}+\frac{y^{2}}{b^{2}}\leqslant1 $，则 $ I=\iint_{D}y^{2}\,\mathrm{d}x\,\mathrm{d}y= $
explanationMarkdown:
由于 $D$ 为椭圆形区域，采用广义极坐标变换。令 $x = a r \cos \theta$，$y = b r \sin \theta$，则区域变为 $D': 0 \leqslant r \leqslant 1$，$0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant 2\pi$。变换的雅可比行列式为：
$$
 J=\frac{\partial(x,y)}{\partial(r,\theta)}=\begin{vmatrix}a\cos\theta & -a r\sin\theta \\ b\sin\theta & b r\cos\theta\end{vmatrix}=a b r. 
$$
 因此，
$$
 \begin{aligned} \iint_{D}y^{2}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y &= \iint_{D^{\prime}}(b r \sin\theta)^{2} |J| \mathrm{d}r\mathrm{d}\theta \\ &= \int_{0}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{1} b^{2} r^{2} \sin^{2}\theta \cdot a b r \, \mathrm{d}r \\ &= a b^{3} \int_{0}^{2\pi} \sin^{2}\theta \, d\theta \int_{0}^{1} r^{3} \, dr \\ &= a b^{3} \cdot \pi \cdot \frac{1}{4} \\ &= \frac{\pi a b^{3}}{4}. \end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid4x^{2}+y^{2}\lt1,x\geqslant0,y\geqslant0\right\} $，则积分 $ I=\iint_{D}(1-12x^{2}-y^{2})dxdy= $
explanationMarkdown:
令 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}x&=\frac{1}{2}r\cos\theta,\\ y&=r\sin\theta,\end{aligned}\right. $ 则区域 $D$ 对应 $0 \le r \le 1$，$0 \le \theta \le \frac{\pi}{2}$，雅可比行列式 $J = \frac{r}{2}$。代入积分：
$$
 \begin{aligned} I &= \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{1} \left(1 - 12 \cdot \frac{r^{2}\cos^{2}\theta}{4} - r^{2}\sin^{2}\theta\right) \cdot \frac{r}{2} \, \mathrm{d}r \\ &= \frac{1}{2} \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \mathrm{d}\theta \int_{0}^{1} (1 - 3r^{2}\cos^{2}\theta - r^{2}\sin^{2}\theta) r \, dr \\ &= \frac{1}{2} \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \mathrm{d}\theta \int_{0}^{1} (1 - r^{2} - 2r^{2}\cos^{2}\theta) r \, dr \\ &= \frac{1}{2} \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \mathrm{d}\theta \int_{0}^{1} (1 - r^{2}) r \, dr - \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \cos^{2}\theta \, d\theta \int_{0}^{1} r^{3} \, dr \\ &= \frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} \cdot \frac{1}{4} - \frac{\pi}{4} \cdot \frac{1}{4} \\ &= \frac{\pi}{16} - \frac{\pi}{16} = 0. \end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid\frac{x^{2}}{a^{2}}+\frac{y^{2}}{b^{2}}\leqslant1\right\} $，常数 $ a\gt0,b\gt0,a\neq b $，计算 $ I=\iint\limits_{D}\left[(x-1)^{2}+(2y+3)^{2}\right]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y $。
explanationMarkdown:
$$
 \begin{aligned} I &= \iint\limits_{D}\left[(x-1)^{2}+(2y+3)^{2}\right]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y \\ &= \iint\limits_{D}(x^{2}+4y^{2})\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y + \iint\limits_{D}(-2x+12y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y + 10\iint\limits_{D}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y \end{aligned} 
$$
 记 $I_1 = \iint_{D}(x^{2}+4y^{2})\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$，$I_2 = \iint_{D}(-2x+12y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$，$I_3 = 10\iint_{D}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$。

由于区域 $D$ 关于 $x$ 轴和 $y$ 轴对称，而被积函数 $-2x$ 和 $12y$ 分别是关于 $x$ 和 $y$ 的奇函数，因此 $I_2 = 0$。

椭圆面积 $\iint_{D} dxdy = \pi a b$，故 $I_3 = 10 \pi a b$。

计算 $I_1$：
$$
 \begin{aligned} \iint_{D}x^{2}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y &= 4\int_{0}^{a} dx \int_{0}^{\frac{b}{a}\sqrt{a^{2}-x^{2}}} x^{2} dy \\ &= \frac{4b}{a} \int_{0}^{a} x^{2} \sqrt{a^{2}-x^{2}} dx \\ &\xlongequal{x=a\sin t} 4a^{3}b \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sin^{2}t \cos^{2}t \, dt \\ &= 4a^{3}b \left( \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sin^{2}t \, dt - \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sin^{4}t \, dt \right) \\ &= 4a^{3}b \left( \frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{3}{4}\cdot\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{\pi}{2} \right) = \frac{1}{4} \pi a^{3} b. \end{aligned} 
$$
 同理，$4\iint_{D} y^{2} dxdy = \pi a b^{3}$。因此 $I_1 = \frac{1}{4} \pi a^{3} b + \pi a b^{3}$。

综上，$I = I_1 + I_2 + I_3 = \frac{1}{4} \pi a^{3} b + \pi a b^{3} + 10 \pi a b$。

contentMarkdown: 设平面区域 D 由曲线 $ y = \sqrt{3(1 - x^{2})} $ 与直线 $ y = \sqrt{3}x $ 及 y 轴所围成. 计算二重积分 $ \iint_{D}(x^{2} + y^{2}) \, dx \, dy. $

$$
 \begin{aligned}&=\frac{9}{4}\int_{\frac{\pi}{3}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{\tan^{2}\theta+1}{(3+\tan^{2}\theta)^{2}}\mathrm{d}(\tan\theta)\\&=\frac{9}{4}\int_{\sqrt{3}}^{+\infty}\frac{t^{2}+1}{(3+t^{2})^{2}}\mathrm{d}t\\&=\frac{9}{4}\int_{\sqrt{3}}^{+\infty}\frac{t^{2}+3-2}{(t^{2}+3)^{2}}\mathrm{d}t\\&=\frac{9}{4}\int_{\sqrt{3}}^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{d}t}{t^{2}+3}-\frac{9}{4}\int_{\sqrt{3}}^{+\infty}\frac{2\mathrm{d}t}{(t^{2}+3)^{2}}\\&=\frac{9}{4}\cdot\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\arctan\frac{t}{\sqrt{3}}\left|_{-\sqrt{3}}^{+\infty}-\frac{1}{4}\left(\frac{3t}{t^{2}+3}+\sqrt{3}\arctan\frac{t}{\sqrt{3}}\right)\right|_{-\sqrt{3}}^{+\infty}\\&=\frac{3\sqrt{3}\pi}{16}-\frac{(\pi-2)\sqrt{3}}{16}=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{8}(1+\pi).\end{aligned}

contentMarkdown: 计算二重积分 $ \iint_{D}(x+y)dxdy $，其中 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leq x+y+1\right\} $.

contentMarkdown:
计算二重积分 $ \iint_{D}(x-y)dxdy $，其中 
$$
 D=\left\{(x,y)\mid(x-1)^{2}+(y-1)^{2}\leq2,y\geq x\right\}

explanationMarkdown:

contentMarkdown: 设区域 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant2x+2y\right\} $，计算积分 $ \iint_{D}(x+y^{2})dxdy. $
explanationMarkdown:
区域 $D$ 是以 $(1,1)$ 为圆心、$\sqrt2$ 为半径的圆盘，面积为 $2\pi$。由形心公式，
$$
\iint_D x\,\mathrm dx\,\mathrm dy=2\pi.
$$
又因为 $D$ 关于直线 $y=x$ 对称，
$$
\iint_D y^2\,\mathrm dx\,\mathrm dy
=\frac12\iint_D(x^2+y^2)\,\mathrm dx\,\mathrm dy.
$$
在原点极坐标下，$D$ 可表示为
$$
-\frac{\pi}{4}\le\theta\le\frac{3\pi}{4},\qquad
0\le r\le2(\sin\theta+\cos\theta).
$$
因此
$$
\begin{aligned}
\iint_D y^2\,\mathrm dx\,\mathrm dy
&=\frac12\int_{-\pi/4}^{3\pi/4}\int_0^{2(\sin\theta+\cos\theta)}r^3\,\mathrm dr\,\mathrm d\theta\\
&=2\int_{-\pi/4}^{3\pi/4}(\sin\theta+\cos\theta)^4\,\mathrm d\theta\\
&=8\int_0^\pi\sin^4t\,\mathrm dt=3\pi.
\end{aligned}
$$
故
$$
\iint_D(x+y^2)\,\mathrm dx\,\mathrm dy=2\pi+3\pi=5\pi.
$$

contentMarkdown: 设平面区域 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid(x-1)^{2}+y^{2}\geqslant1,(x-2)^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant4,y\geqslant x\right\} $，计算 $ \iint_{D}(x^{2}+y^{2})\mathrm{d}\sigma $.
explanationMarkdown:
极坐标下，$(x-1)^2+y^2\ge1$ 给出 $r\ge2\cos\theta$，$(x-2)^2+y^2\le4$ 给出 $r\le4\cos\theta$，再结合 $y\ge x$，可得 $\dfrac{\pi}{4}\le\theta\le\dfrac{\pi}{2}$。因此
$$
\iint_D(x^2+y^2)\,\mathrm d\sigma=\int_{\pi/4}^{\pi/2}\int_{2\cos\theta}^{4\cos\theta}r^3\,\mathrm dr\,\mathrm d\theta=60\int_{\pi/4}^{\pi/2}\cos^4\theta\,\mathrm d\theta=\frac{45\pi}{8}-15.
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D: 2x \leqslant x^{2} + y^{2}, 0 \leqslant y \leqslant x \leqslant 2 $，则 $ I = \iint_{D} \frac{dxdy}{\sqrt{x^{2} + y^{2}}} = $ ___
explanationMarkdown:
解：D 如图 5-11 所示，采用极坐标。 $ x^{2} + y^{2} = 2x $ 的极坐标方程为 $ r = 2\cos\theta, x = 2 $ 的极坐标方程为 $ r = 2\sec\theta $， $ v = x $ 的极坐标方程为 $ \theta = \frac{\pi}{4} $，故 
$$
 \begin{aligned}I&=\iint_{D}\frac{\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{2\cos\theta}^{2\sec\theta}\frac{1}{r}\bullet r\mathrm{d}r\\&=2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}(\sec\theta-\cos\theta)\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=2(\ln|\sec\theta+\tan\theta|-\sin\theta)\bigg|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\\&=2\ln(1+\sqrt{2})-\sqrt{2}.\\ \end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D: x^2 + y^2 \leq 2x $，则 $ I = \iint_D (2x + 3y) \, \mathrm{d}x \, \mathrm{d}y = $ ___
explanationMarkdown:
解：D 如图 5-13 所示，利用极坐标， 
$$
 \begin{aligned}I&=\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2\cos\theta}(2r\cos\theta+3r\sin\theta)r\mathrm{d}r\\&=\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\left(\frac{16}{3}\cos^{4}\theta+8\cos^{3}\theta\cdot\sin\theta\right)\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=\frac{32}{3}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\cos^{4}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta+0=\frac{32}{3}\times\frac{3}{4}\times\frac{1}{2}\times\frac{\pi}{2}=2\pi.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D:1 \leqslant x^{2} + y^{2} \leqslant 2x, y \geqslant 0 $，计算 $ I = \iint_{D} \frac{y}{\left(1 + x^{2} + y^{2}\right) \sqrt{x^{2} + y^{2}}} \, \mathrm{d}x \, \mathrm{d}y $
explanationMarkdown:
解 D 如图 5-21 所示，由 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}x^{2}+y^{2}=1\\ x^{2}+y^{2}=2x\end{aligned}\right. $ 解得交点 $ A\left(\frac{1}{2},\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right) $。
$$
 \begin{aligned}I=&\iint_{D}\frac{y}{\left(1+x^{2}+y^{2}\right)\cdot\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\=&\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{3}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{1}^{2\cos\theta}\frac{\sin\theta}{1+r^{2}}\cdot r\mathrm{d}r\\=&\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{3}}\sin\theta\left[\ln(1+r^{2})\bigg|_{1}^{2\cos\theta}\right]\mathrm{d}\theta\\=&\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{3}}\left[\ln(1+4\cos^{2}\theta)-\ln2\right]\sin\theta\mathrm{d}\theta\\&\xlongequal{u=\cos\theta}\frac{1}{2}\int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{1}\left[\ln(1+4u^{2})-\ln2\right]\mathrm{d}u\\=&\frac{1}{2}\left[u\ln(1+4u^{2})-2u+\arctan2u\right]\bigg|_{\frac{1}{2}}^{1}-\frac{1}{4}\ln2\\=&\frac{1}{2}\left(\ln\frac{5}{2}-1+\arctan2-\frac{\pi}{4}\right).\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设平面区域 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid(x-1)^{2}+(y-1)^{2}\leqslant1\right\} $，则 $ \iint_{D}(x^{2}+y^{2})\mathrm{d}\sigma= $ ___
explanationMarkdown:
【答案】 $ \frac{5\pi}{2} $
【解析】方法一 令 $ x = 1 + r \cos \theta, y = 1 + r \sin \theta $，则
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint\limits_{D}(x^{2}+y^{2})\mathrm{d}\sigma&=\int_{0}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{1}(r^{2}+2r\cos\theta+2r\sin\theta+2)r\mathrm{d}r\\&=\int_{0}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{1}(r^{3}+2r^{2}\cos\theta+2r^{2}\sin\theta+2r)\mathrm{d}r\\&=\int_{0}^{2\pi}\left(\frac{5}{4}+\frac{2}{3}\cos\theta+\frac{2}{3}\sin\theta\right)\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=\left.\left(\frac{5}{4}\theta+\frac{2}{3}\sin\theta-\frac{2}{3}\cos\theta\right)\right|_{0}^{2\pi}\end{aligned} 
$$
$$
 =\frac{5\pi}{2}. 
$$
方法二 作变换 $ x = u + 1, y = v + 1 $，在此变换下，与 D 对应的闭区域为 $ D' = \left\{(u, v) \mid u^{2} + v^{2} \leqslant 1\right\} $，则有
$$
 J(u,v)=\frac{\partial(x,y)}{\partial(u,v)}=1, 
$$
从而有
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}(x^{2}+y^{2})\mathrm{d}\sigma&=\iint_{D'}\left[(u+1)^{2}+(v+1)^{2}\right]\mid J(u,v)\mid\mathrm{d}\sigma\\&=\iint_{D'}(u^{2}+v^{2}+2)\mathrm{d}\sigma\\&=\iint_{D'}(u^{2}+v^{2})\mathrm{d}\sigma+\iint_{D'}2\mathrm{d}\sigma\\&=\int_{0}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{1}r^{3}\mathrm{d}r+2\pi\\&=\frac{5\pi}{2}.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid(x-1)^{2}+(y-1)^{2}\leqslant2\right\} $，则 $ \iint_{D}(x+y)\mathrm{d}\sigma= $ ___
explanationMarkdown:
【答案】 $ 4\pi $
【解析】方法一 在极坐标系中，将 $ (x-1)^{2}+(y-1)^{2}=2 $化为
$$
 r=2(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)=2\sqrt{2}\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{4}+\theta\right). 
$$
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}(x+y)\mathrm{d}\sigma&=\int_{-\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{3\pi}{4}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2\sqrt{2}\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{4}+\theta\right)}r^{2}\left(\cos\theta+\sin\theta\right)\mathrm{d}r\\&=\int_{-\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{3\pi}{4}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2\sqrt{2}\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{4}+\theta\right)}\sqrt{2}r^{2}\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{4}+\theta\right)\mathrm{d}r\\&=\frac{2^{5}}{3}\int_{-\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{3\pi}{4}}\sin^{4}\left(\frac{\pi}{4}+\theta\right)\mathrm{d}\theta=\frac{2^{5}}{3}\int_{0}^{\pi}\sin^{4}t\mathrm{d}t\\&=\frac{64}{3}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sin^{4}t\mathrm{d}t=\frac{64}{3}\cdot\frac{3}{4}\cdot\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{\pi}{2}=4\pi.\end{aligned} 
$$
方法二 用直角坐标。
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}(x+y)\mathrm{d}\sigma&=\iint_{D}[(x-1)+(y-1)+2]\mathrm{d}\sigma\\&=\iint_{D}(x-1)\mathrm{d}\sigma+\iint_{D}(y-1)\mathrm{d}\sigma+2\iint_{D}\mathrm{d}\sigma.\end{aligned} 
$$
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}(x-1)\mathrm{d}\sigma=&\int_{1-\sqrt{2}}^{1+\sqrt{2}}\mathrm{d}x\int_{1-\sqrt{2-(x-1)^{2}}}^{1+\sqrt{2-(x-1)^{2}}}(x-1)\mathrm{d}y\\=&\int_{1-\sqrt{2}}^{1+\sqrt{2}}2(x-1)\sqrt{2-(x-1)^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\xlongequal{x-1=t}\int_{-\sqrt{2}}^{\sqrt{2}}2t\sqrt{2-t^{2}}\mathrm{d}t=0.\end{aligned} 
$$
同理， $ \iint_{D}(y-1)\mathrm{d}\sigma=0 $，而 $ 2\iint_{D}\mathrm{d}\sigma=2\cdot2\pi=4\pi $，所以原式 $ =4\pi $。

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant4,(x-1)^{2}+y^{2}\geqslant1,y\geqslant0\right\} $，计算 $ \iint_{D}(xy+y^{2})\mathrm{d}\sigma $
explanationMarkdown:
用极坐标表示区域：当 $0\le\theta\le\frac{\pi}{2}$ 时，$2\cos\theta\le r\le2$；当 $\frac{\pi}{2}\le\theta\le\pi$ 时，$0\le r\le2$。因此 
$$
\begin{aligned}\iint_D(xy+y^2)\,d\sigma&=\int_0^{\pi/2}\int_{2\cos\theta}^{2}r^3(\sin\theta\cos\theta+\sin^2\theta)\,dr\,d\theta\\&\quad+\int_{\pi/2}^{\pi}\int_0^{2}r^3(\sin\theta\cos\theta+\sin^2\theta)\,dr\,d\theta\\&=2\pi-4\int_0^{\pi/2}\left(\cos^5\theta\sin\theta+\cos^4\theta\sin^2\theta\right)d\theta\\&=2\pi-4\left(\frac16+\frac{\pi}{32}\right)=\frac{15\pi}{8}-\frac23.\end{aligned}
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid -x\leqslant y\leqslant x, x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant 2x\right\} $，计算二重积分 $ \iint_{D}(y+\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}})\,\mathrm{d}\sigma $.
explanationMarkdown:
积分区域如图所示，利用对称性及使用极坐标可知
$$
 \begin{aligned}&\iint_{D}(y+\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}})\mathrm{d}\sigma\\=&\iint_{D}y\mathrm{d}\sigma+\iint_{D}\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}\mathrm{d}\sigma\\=&0+2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2\cos\theta}r^{2}\mathrm{d}r\\=&\frac{16}{3}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\cos^{3}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta\\=&\frac{16}{3}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}(1-\sin^{2}\theta)\cos\theta\mathrm{d}\theta\\=&\frac{16}{3}\left(\sin\theta-\frac{1}{3}\sin^{3}\theta\right)\bigg|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}=\frac{16}{3}\left(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}-\frac{1}{3}\cdot\frac{\sqrt{2}}{4}\right)\\=&\frac{20}{9}\sqrt{2}.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 计算二重积分 $ \iint_{D} \sqrt{1 - x^{2} - y^{2}} \, \mathrm{d}\sigma $，其中 $ D = \{(x, y) \mid x^{2} + y^{2} \leqslant y\} $.
explanationMarkdown:
如图所示，由对称性，用极坐标.
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint\limits_{D}\sqrt{1-x^{2}-y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{\sin\theta}\sqrt{1-r^{2}}r\mathrm{d}r\\&=-\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{\sin\theta}(1-r^{2})^{\frac{1}{2}}\mathrm{d}(1-r^{2})\\&=-\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{2}{3}(1-r^{2})^{\frac{3}{2}}\bigg|_{0}^{\sin\theta}\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=-\frac{2}{3}\cdot\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(\cos^{3}\theta-1)\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=-\frac{2}{3}\left(\frac{2}{3}-\frac{\pi}{2}\right)=\frac{\pi}{3}-\frac{4}{9}.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D: -1 \leqslant x \leqslant 0, 1 - \sqrt{1 - x^{2}} \leqslant y \leqslant -x $，则 $ I = \iint_{D} \frac{dxdy}{\sqrt{x^{2} + y^{2}} \sqrt{4 - x^{2} - y^{2}}} = $ ___
explanationMarkdown:
解 D 如图 5-10 所示，用极坐标有 $ \frac{3\pi}{4} \leqslant \theta \leqslant \pi, 0 \leqslant r \leqslant 2\sin\theta $ ，故
$$
 \begin{aligned}I&=\int_{\frac{3\pi}{4}}^{\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2\sin\theta}\frac{r}{r\sqrt{4-r^{2}}}\mathrm{d}r\\&=\int_{\frac{3\pi}{4}}^{\pi}\arcsin\frac{r}{2}\bigg|_{0}^{2\sin\theta}\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=\int_{\frac{3\pi}{4}}^{\pi}(\pi-\theta)\mathrm{d}\theta=\frac{\pi^{2}}{32}.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 计算二重积分 $ \iint_{D}(x-y)dxdy $，其中区域 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid\sqrt{2x-x^{2}}\leqslant y\leqslant 2,0\leqslant x\leqslant 2\right\} $.
explanationMarkdown:
方法一 利用直角坐标计算. 记 $ I=\iint_{D}(x-y)dxdy $，则
$$
 I=\int_{0}^{2}\mathrm{d}x\int_{\sqrt{2x-x^{2}}}^{2}(x-y)\mathrm{d}y=-\left.\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{2}(x-y)^{2}\right|_{y=\sqrt{2x-x^{2}}}^{y=2}\mathrm{d}x 
$$
$$
 \begin{aligned}=&-\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{2}\left[(x-2)^{2}-(x-\sqrt{2x-x^{2}})^{2}\right]\mathrm{d}x\\=&-\frac{1}{6}(x-2)^{3}\left|_{0}^{2}\right.+\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{2}(2x-2x\sqrt{2x-x^{2}})\mathrm{d}x\\=&-\frac{4}{3}+2-\int_{0}^{2}x\sqrt{2x-x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x.\end{aligned} 
$$
作变量代换 $ x-1=\sin t $，并利用定积分的对称性，则
$$
 \begin{aligned}\int_{0}^{2}x\sqrt{2x-x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x&=\int_{0}^{2}x\sqrt{1-(x-1)^{2}}\mathrm{d}x=\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(1+\sin t)\cos^{2}t\mathrm{d}t\\&=2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\cos^{2}t\mathrm{d}t=\frac{\pi}{2},\end{aligned} 
$$
所以 $ I=\frac{2}{3}-\frac{\pi}{2} $
方法二 利用二重积分对区域的可加性. 记 $ D_{1}=\left\{(x,y)\mid0\leqslant y\leqslant\sqrt{2x-x^{2}},0\leqslant x\leqslant 2\right\} $，因为
$$
 \iint_{D_{1}+D}(x-y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\int_{0}^{2}\mathrm{d}y\int_{0}^{2}(x-y)\mathrm{d}x=2\int_{0}^{2}(1-y)\mathrm{d}y=0, 
$$
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D_{1}}(x-y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(\cos\theta-\sin\theta)\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2\cos\theta}r^{2}\mathrm{d}r=\frac{8}{3}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(\cos\theta-\sin\theta)\cos^{3}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=\frac{8}{3}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\cos^{4}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta-\frac{8}{3}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sin\theta\cos^{3}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=\frac{8}{3}\times\frac{3}{4}\times\frac{1}{2}\times\frac{\pi}{2}+\frac{8}{3}\times\frac{1}{4}\cos^{4}\theta\Big|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}=\frac{\pi}{2}-\frac{2}{3},\end{aligned} 
$$
所以
$$
 I=\iint\limits_{D_{1}+D}(x-y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y-\iint\limits_{D_{1}}(x-y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\frac{2}{3}-\frac{\pi}{2}. 
$$

contentMarkdown: 计算 $ \iint_{D}\left[(x+1)^{2}+(y-1)^{2}\right]dxdy $，其中 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant 2x, x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant 2y\right\} $
explanationMarkdown:
由于 D 关于直线 y = x 对称，记 D 在直线 y = x 下方的部分为 $ D_{1} $，则
$$
 \begin{aligned}&\iint_{D}\left[(x+1)^{2}+(y-1)^{2}\right]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint_{D}\left[x^{2}+y^{2}+2+2(x-y)\right]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&=2\iint_{\tilde{D}_{1}}(x^{2}+y^{2}+2)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2\sin\theta}(r^{3}+2r)\mathrm{d}r\\&=8\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}(\sin^{4}\theta+\sin^{2}\theta)\mathrm{d}\theta=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}(7-8\cos2\theta+\cos4\theta)\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=\left.\left(7\theta-4\sin2\theta+\frac{1}{4}\sin4\theta\right)\right|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}=\frac{7}{4}\pi-4.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 已知平面区域 $ D = \{(x, y) \mid |x| \leqslant y, (x^{2} + y^{2})^{3} \leqslant y^{4}\} $，则 $ \iint_{D} \frac{|x|}{\sqrt{x^{2} + y^{2}}} \, dx \, dy = $ ___.
explanationMarkdown:
因为 D 关于 y 轴对称，所以 
$$
 \iint_{D}\frac{|x|}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=2\iint_{D_{1}}\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y, 
$$
 其中 $ D_{1} $ 是 D 位于 y 轴右侧的部分，如图所示。在极坐标系中， $ D_{1}=\left\{(r,\theta)\mid\frac{\pi}{4}\leqslant\theta\leqslant\frac{\pi}{2},0\leqslant r\leqslant\sin^{2}\theta\right\} $，所以 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}\frac{|x|}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=2\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{\sin^{2}\theta}r\cos\theta\mathrm{d}r=\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sin^{4}\theta\mathrm{d}(\sin\theta)\\&=\frac{1}{5}\sin^{5}\theta\Big|_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}=\frac{1}{5}\left(1-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{8}\right).\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 曲线 $ (x^{2}+y^{2})^{2}=x^{2}-y^{2}(x\geqslant0,y\geqslant0) $ 与 x 轴围成的区域为 D，求 $ \iint_{D}xy\,dx\,dy $.
explanationMarkdown:
分析：本题主要考查二重积分的计算。曲线 $ (x^{2}+y^{2})^{2}=x^{2}-y^{2}(x\geqslant0,y\geqslant0) $ 为双纽线在第一象限的部分。由该曲线与 x 轴所围区域 D 在直角坐标下的表示较难写，但是在极坐标下的表示较简单，故可以考虑在极坐标下计算所求二重积分。解：曲线 $ (x^{2}+y^{2})^{2}=x^{2}-y^{2}(x\geqslant0,y\geqslant0) $ 与 x 轴围成的区域 D 如图所示。写出曲线 $ (x^{2}+y^{2})^{2}=x^{2}-y^{2} $ 的极坐标方程。将 $ x=r\cos\theta, y=r\sin\theta $ 代入 $ (x^{2}+y^{2})^{2}=x^{2}-y^{2} $ 可得， $ r^{4}=r^{2}\cos2\theta $，即 $ r^{2}=\cos2\theta $。于是，区域 D 的极坐标表示为 
$$
 D=\left\{(r,\theta)\middle|0\leqslant r\leqslant\sqrt{\cos2\theta},0\leqslant\theta\leqslant\frac{\pi}{4}\right\}. 
$$
 因此， 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint\limits_{D}xy\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&\xlongequal{ 极坐标 }\iint\limits_{D}r\cos\theta\cdot r\sin\theta\cdot r\mathrm{d}r\mathrm{d}\theta=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin\theta\cos\theta\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{\sqrt{\cos2\theta}}r^{3}\mathrm{d}r\\&=\left.\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin2\theta\cdot\frac{r^{4}}{4}\right|_{0}^{\sqrt{\cos2\theta}}\mathrm{d}\theta=\left.\frac{1}{8}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin2\theta\cdot\cos^{2}2\theta\mathrm{d}\theta\right.\\&=-\left.\frac{1}{16}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\cos^{2}2\theta\mathrm{d}(\cos2\theta)\right.\\&=-\left.\frac{1}{16}\times\left(0-\frac{1}{3}\right)=\frac{1}{48}\right..\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设平面有界区域D位于第一象限，由曲线 $ x^{2}+y^{2}-xy=1 $, $ x^{2}+y^{2}-xy=2 $ 与直线 $ y=\sqrt{3}x $, $ y=0 $ 围成，计算 $ \iint_{D}\frac{1}{3x^{2}+y^{2}}dxdy $.
explanationMarkdown: 解 在极坐标系下计算。由 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}x&=r\cos\theta,\\ y&=r\sin\theta\end{aligned}\right. $，可知，曲线 $ x^{2}+y^{2}-xy=1 $, $ x^{2}+y^{2}-xy=2 $ 的极坐标方程分别为 $ r^{2}-r^{2}\sin\theta\cos\theta=1 $, $ r^{2}-r^{2}\sin\theta\cos\theta=2 $，即 $ r=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-\sin\theta\cos\theta}} $, $ r=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{1-\sin\theta\cos\theta}} $。直线 $ y=\sqrt{3}x $ 的极坐标方程为 $ \theta=\frac{\pi}{3} $。于是，区域 D 在极坐标系下的表示为 $ D=\left\{(r,\theta)\left|\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-\sin\theta\cos\theta}}\leqslant r\leqslant\frac{\sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{1-\sin\theta\cos\theta}},0\leqslant\theta\leqslant\frac{\pi}{3}\right.\right\} $。因此，$ \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}\frac{1}{3x^{2}+y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&\xlongequal{ 极坐标 }\iint_{D}\frac{rdr\mathrm{d}\theta}{3r^{2}\cos^{2}\theta+r^{2}\sin^{2}\theta}=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{3}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-\sin\theta\cos\theta}}}^{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{1-\sin\theta\cos\theta}}}\frac{rdr}{3r^{2}\cos^{2}\theta+r^{2}\sin^{2}\theta}\\&=\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{3}}\frac{1}{3\cos^{2}\theta+\sin^{2}\theta}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-\sin\theta\cos\theta}}}^{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{1-\sin\theta\cos\theta}}}\frac{\mathrm{d}(r^{2})}{r^{2}}\\&=\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{3}}\frac{1}{3\cos^{2}\theta+\sin^{2}\theta}\cdot\ln r^{2}\Bigg|_{\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-\sin\theta\cos\theta}}}^{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{1-\sin\theta\cos\theta}}}\mathrm{d}\theta=\frac{\ln2}{2}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{3}}\frac{\mathrm{d}\theta}{\cos^{2}\theta(3+\tan^{2}\theta)}\\&=\ln2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{3}}\frac{\mathrm{d}(\tan\theta)}{3+\tan^{2}\theta}\xlongequal{t=\tan\theta}\frac{\ln2}{2}\int_{0}^{\sqrt{3}}\frac{\mathrm{d}t}{3+t^{2}}=\frac{\ln2}{2\sqrt{3}}\int_{0}^{\sqrt{3}}\frac{\mathrm{d}\left(\frac{t}{\sqrt{3}}\right)}{1+\left(\frac{t}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^{2}}\\&=\frac{\sqrt{3}\ln2}{6}\arctan\frac{t}{\sqrt{3}}\Bigg|_{0}^{\sqrt{3}}=\frac{\sqrt{3}\ln2}{6}\cdot\frac{\pi}{4}=\frac{\sqrt{3}\pi\ln2}{24}.\end{aligned} $

（I）将曲线
$$
(x^2+y^2)^2=2(x^2-y^2)
$$
化为极坐标方程，得
$$
r^2=2\cos 2\theta.
$$
积分区域关于 $x$ 轴对称，而被积函数 $xy$ 关于 $y$ 为奇函数，因此
$$
\iint_D xy\,\mathrm dx\,\mathrm dy=0.
$$

（II）将曲线
$$
(x^2+y^2)^2=2xy
$$
化为极坐标方程，得
$$
r^2=\sin 2\theta.
$$
区域由第一、第三象限内两个关于原点对称的叶片组成。第一象限叶片可表示为
$$
0\le\theta\le\frac{\pi}{2},
\qquad
0\le r\le\sqrt{\sin 2\theta}.
$$
由于 $xy$ 在两个叶片上的积分相同，
$$
\begin{aligned}
\iint_D xy\,\mathrm dx\,\mathrm dy
&=2\int_0^{\pi/2}\int_0^{\sqrt{\sin 2\theta}}
r^2\cos\theta\sin\theta\cdot r\,\mathrm dr\,\mathrm d\theta\\
&=\frac14\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^3 2\theta\,\mathrm d\theta\\
&=\frac18\int_0^\pi\sin^3 u\,\mathrm du\\
&=\frac16.
\end{aligned}
$$
以上极坐标范围已经完整说明积分区域，计算不依赖额外图例。

contentMarkdown: 设平面区域 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{3}+y^{3}\geqslant\left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right)^{2},x+y\geqslant1\right\} $. 计算 $ \iint_{D}\frac{x+y}{x^{2}+y^{2}}d\sigma $.
explanationMarkdown:
积分区域如图所示。
$$
 \begin{aligned} 原式 &=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{\frac{1}{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}}^{\cos^{3}\theta+\sin^{3}\theta}(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)\mathrm{d}r\\&=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}[(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)(\cos^{3}\theta+\sin^{3}\theta)-1]\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(\cos^{4}\theta+\cos\theta\sin^{3}\theta+\sin\theta\cos^{3}\theta+\sin^{4}\theta)\mathrm{d}\theta-\frac{\pi}{2}\\&=2\cdot\frac{3}{4}\cdot\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{\pi}{2}+\frac{1}{4}\sin^{4}\theta\bigg|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}-\frac{1}{4}\cos^{4}\theta\bigg|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}-\frac{\pi}{2}\\&=\frac{1}{2}-\frac{\pi}{8}.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ f(x,y)=\left\{\begin{aligned}&x-y+1,&x+y\leqslant1\\ &\frac{(x+y)^{2}}{x^{2}+y^{2}},&x+y\gt1\end{aligned}\right. $， $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x+y+xy\geqslant1,x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant1, x \geqslant 0, y \geqslant 0 \right\} $，计算 $ I = \iint_{D} f(x, y) \, dx \, dy. $
explanationMarkdown:
曲线 $x+y+xy=1$ 可写成
$$
y=\frac{1-x}{1+x}.
$$
直线 $x+y=1$ 将 $D$ 分为 $D_1$ 与 $D_2$。在 $D_1$ 上，区域关于 $y=x$ 对称，故
$$
\iint_{D_1}(x-y)\,\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=0,
$$
从而
$$
I_1=\iint_{D_1}1\,\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y
=\int_0^1\left(1-x-\frac{1-x}{1+x}\right)\mathrm{d}x
=\frac32-2\ln2.
$$
在 $D_2$ 上用极坐标，有
$$
0\leqslant\theta\leqslant\frac{\pi}{2},\qquad
\frac{1}{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}\leqslant r\leqslant1.
$$
因此
$$
\begin{aligned}
I_2&=\int_0^{\pi/2}\int_{1/(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)}^1
\left(\cos\theta+\sin\theta\right)^2 r\,\mathrm{d}r\mathrm{d}\theta\\
&=\frac12.
\end{aligned}
$$
故
$$
I=I_1+I_2=2-2\ln2.
$$

contentMarkdown: 设平面区域 $ D = \{(x, y) \mid 2x^{2} + y^{2} \leqslant 2\sqrt{x^{2} + y^{2}}, y \geqslant x \geqslant 0\} $，若 $ \iint_{D} \frac{f(x, y)}{\sqrt{1 - x^{2}}} \, \mathrm{d}\sigma = a \gt 0 $， $ f(x,y) $ 是 D 上的连续函数。 (1) 计算 $ \iint_{D} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}} d\sigma; $ (2) 证明: 存在 $ (\xi, \eta) \in D $，使得 $ |f(\xi, \eta)| \geqslant \frac{\sqrt{2}}{\pi} a. $
explanationMarkdown:
(1) $ 2x^{2}+y^{2}=2\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}} $ 在极坐标系下为 $ r(1+\cos^{2}\theta)=2 $，直角坐标系下的积分区域D如图所示。则
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}\mathrm{d}\sigma&=\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{\frac{2}{1+\cos^{2}\theta}}\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-r^{2}\cos^{2}\theta}}r\mathrm{d}r=2\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{1}{1+\cos^{2}\theta}\mathrm{d}\theta\\ &=2\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{\sec^{2}\theta}{\sec^{2}\theta+1}\mathrm{d}\theta=2\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{\mathrm{d}(\tan\theta)}{2+\tan^{2}\theta}\\ &\xlongequal{u=\tan\theta}2\int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{2+u^{2}}=\sqrt{2}\arctan\frac{u}{\sqrt{2}}\bigg|_{1}^{+\infty}=\sqrt{2}\cdot\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\arctan\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right)\\ &=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\pi-\sqrt{2}\arctan\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}.\end{aligned} 
$$
 
(2) 由积分保号性可得，
$$
 \begin{aligned}&a=\iint_{D}\frac{f(x,y)}{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}\mathrm{d}\sigma=\left|\iint_{D}\frac{f(x,y)}{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}\mathrm{d}\sigma\right|\leqslant\iint_{D}\frac{\left|f(x,y)\right|}{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}\mathrm{d}\sigma\\ &\xlongequal{ 积分中值 }\left|f(\xi,\eta)\right|\left|\iint_{D}\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}\mathrm{d}\sigma\right.\\ &=\left(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\pi-\sqrt{2}\arctan\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right)\left|f(\xi,\eta)\right|((\xi,\eta)\in D),\end{aligned} 
$$
 
即存在 $ (\xi,\eta)\in D $，使得 $ a\leqslant\left(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\pi-\sqrt{2}\arctan\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right)\mid f(\xi,\eta)\mid $，即
$$
 f(\xi,\eta)\geqslant\frac{a}{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\pi-\sqrt{2}\arctan\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}}\geqslant\frac{a}{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\pi}=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{\pi}a. 
$$
