explanationMarkdown:
令 $x=r\cos\theta,y=r\sin\theta$。两条曲线分别化为 
$$
r^8=r^6(\cos^6\theta+\sin^6\theta),\qquad 4r^8=r^6(\cos^6\theta+\sin^6\theta),
$$
 即 
$$
r=\sqrt{\cos^6\theta+\sin^6\theta},\qquad r=\frac12\sqrt{\cos^6\theta+\sin^6\theta}.
$$
 因区域在第一象限，故 $0\le\theta\le\dfrac\pi2$。又 
$$
\sqrt{x^6+y^6}=r^3\sqrt{\cos^6\theta+\sin^6\theta},\qquad (x^2+y^2)^2=r^4,
$$
 乘上雅可比因子 $r$ 后，被积表达式化为 
$$
\sqrt{\cos^6\theta+\sin^6\theta}\,dr\,d\theta.
$$
 因此 
$$
\begin{aligned}I&=\int_0^{\pi/2}\int_{\frac12\sqrt{\cos^6\theta+\sin^6\theta}}^{\sqrt{\cos^6\theta+\sin^6\theta}}\sqrt{\cos^6\theta+\sin^6\theta}\,dr\,d\theta\\&=\frac12\int_0^{\pi/2}(\cos^6\theta+\sin^6\theta)\,d\theta=\int_0^{\pi/2}\cos^6\theta\,d\theta=\frac{5\pi}{32}.\end{aligned}
$$
sourceText: 24 李艳芳三套数二第三套

contentMarkdown: 设 $D=\left\{(x,y)\mid4x^{2}y^{2}\leqslant(x^{2}+y^{2})^{3}\leqslant16x^{2}y^{2},x\geqslant0,y\geqslant0\right\}$，计算积分 $I=\iint_{D}(x^{2}+y^{2}+xy)dxdy$。
explanationMarkdown:
将区域边界曲线转化为极坐标，得 $(x^{2}+y^{2})^{3}=4x^{2}y^{2}: r=\sin2\theta$， $(x^{2}+y^{2})^{3}=16x^{2}y^{2}: r=2\sin2\theta$。 
$$
\begin{aligned}I&=\iint_{D}(x^{2}+y^{2}+xy)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{\sin2\theta}^{2\sin2\theta}(r^{2}+r^{2}\cos\theta\sin\theta)r\mathrm{d}r\\&=\frac{15}{4}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(\sin^{4}2\theta+\sin^{4}2\theta\cos\theta\sin\theta)\mathrm{d}\theta.\end{aligned}
$$
 
$$
\frac{15}{4}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sin^{4}2\theta\mathrm{d}\theta=\frac{15}{8}\int_{0}^{\pi}\sin^{4}t\mathrm{d}t=\frac{15}{4}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sin^{4}t\mathrm{d}t=\frac{15}{4}\cdot\frac{3}{4}\cdot\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{\pi}{2}=\frac{45}{64}\pi,
$$
 
$$
\frac{15}{4}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sin^{4}2\theta\cos\theta\sin\theta\mathrm{d}\theta=\frac{15}{16}\int_{0}^{\pi}\sin^{5}t\mathrm{d}t=\frac{15}{8}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sin^{5}t\mathrm{d}t=\frac{15}{8}\cdot\frac{4}{5}\cdot\frac{2}{3}=1,
$$
 故 $I=\frac{45}{64}\pi+1.$

【详解】（1）设 $x = r \cos \theta, y = r \sin \theta$，代入 $(x^{2} + y^{2})^{3} = 4x^{2}y^{2}$ 得 $r^{2} = \sin^{2}2\theta$。 $D_{1}:0\leqslant\theta\leqslant\frac{\pi}{2},0\leqslant r\leqslant\sin2\theta$， 
$$
\begin{aligned}\iint_{D}\mid x y\mid\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=4\iint_{D_{1}}x y\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=4\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{\sin2\theta}r^{3}\cos\theta\sin\theta\mathrm{d}r\\&=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\cos\theta\sin\theta\sin^{4}2\theta\mathrm{d}\theta=\frac{1}{4}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sin^{5}2\theta\mathrm{d}2\theta\\&=\frac{1}{4}\int_{0}^{\pi}\sin^{5}t\mathrm{d}t=\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sin^{5}t\mathrm{d}t=\frac{1}{2}\times\frac{4}{5}\times\frac{2}{3}=\frac{4}{15}.\end{aligned}
$$
 （2）由 $(x^{2}+y^{2})^{2}=2a^{2}(x^{2}-y^{2})$，得 $r^{2}=2a^{2}\cos2\theta$。设 $D_{1}:0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant \frac{\pi}{6}$， $a \leqslant r \leqslant a\sqrt{2\cos 2\theta}$，则 $\cos 2\theta = \frac{1}{2}$， $2\theta = \frac{\pi}{3}$。 
$$
A=4\iint_{D_{1}}dxdy=4\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{6}}d\theta\int_{a}^{a\sqrt{2\cos2\theta}}rdr=a^{2}\left(\sqrt{3}-\frac{\pi}{3}\right).
$$

contentMarkdown: 已知曲线 L 的极坐标方程为 $ r = \sin 3\theta\left(0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant \frac{\pi}{3}\right) $，D 为曲线 L 围成的区域，则 $ \iint_{D} \sqrt{x^{2} + y^{2}} \, dx \, dy = $ ___.
explanationMarkdown:
【解析】 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint\limits_{D}\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{3}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{\sin3\theta}\sqrt{r^{2}\cos^{2}\theta+r^{2}\sin^{2}\theta}\cdot r\mathrm{d}r\\&=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{3}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{\sin3\theta}r^{2}\mathrm{d}r=\frac{1}{3}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{3}}\sin^{3}3\theta\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=\frac{1}{9}\int_{0}^{\pi}\sin^{3}t\mathrm{d}t=\frac{2}{9}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sin^{3}t\mathrm{d}t=\frac{2}{9}\cdot\frac{2}{3}=\frac{4}{27}.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设平面区域 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid y-2\leq x\leq\sqrt{4-y^{2}},0\leq y\leq2\right\} $，计算二重积分 $ \iint_{D}\frac{(x-y)^{2}}{x^{2}+y^{2}}dxdy $.
explanationMarkdown:
由区域 $ D $ 的边界 $ x^{2}+y^{2}=4 $ 和 $ y=x+2 $，转换为极坐标 $ x=r\cos\theta, y=r\sin\theta $。边界方程变为 $ r=2 $ 和 $ r=\frac{2}{\sin\theta-\cos\theta} $。积分区域分为两部分：$ 0\leq\theta\leq\frac{\pi}{2} $ 时 $ 0\leq r\leq2 $；$ \frac{\pi}{2}\leq\theta\leq\pi $ 时 $ 0\leq r\leq\frac{2}{\sin\theta-\cos\theta} $。
$$
 \begin{aligned}I&=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}d\theta\int_{0}^{2}\frac{r^{2}(\cos\theta-\sin\theta)^{2}}{r^{2}}\cdot r\cdot dr+\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi}d\theta\int_{0}^{\frac{2}{\sin\theta-\cos\theta}}\frac{r^{2}(\cos\theta-\sin\theta)^{2}}{r^{2}}\cdot r\cdot dr\\ &=2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(1-\sin2\theta)d\theta+2\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi}d\theta\\ &=2\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-1\right)+\pi=2\pi-2\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 计算二重积分 $ \iint_{D}\frac{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}{\sqrt{4a^{2}-x^{2}-y^{2}}}\mathrm{d}\sigma $，其中D是由曲线 $ y=-a+\sqrt{a^{2}-x^{2}}(a>0) $和直线y=-x围成的区域.
explanationMarkdown:
曲线 $ y=-a+\sqrt{a^{2}-x^{2}} $ 即 $ x^{2}+(y+a)^{2}=a^{2} $，圆心在 $(0,-a)$，半径 $ a $。与直线 $ y=-x $ 相交。采用极坐标 $ x=r\cos\theta, y=r\sin\theta $，区域为 $ -\frac{\pi}{4}\leq\theta\leq0, 0\leq r\leq-2a\sin\theta $。
$$
 \iint_{D}\frac{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}{\sqrt{4a^{2}-x^{2}-y^{2}}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\int_{-\frac{\pi}{4}}^{0}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{-2a\sin\theta}\frac{r^{2}}{\sqrt{4a^{2}-r^{2}}}\mathrm{d}r 
$$
对 $ r $ 积分，令 $ r=2a\sin t $：
$$
 \begin{aligned}\int_{0}^{-2a\sin\theta}\frac{r^{2}}{\sqrt{4a^{2}-r^{2}}}\mathrm{d}r &=\int_{0}^{-\theta}4a^{2}\sin^{2}t\,dt=4a^{2}\int_{0}^{-\theta}\sin^{2}t\,dt\\ &=2a^{2}\int_{0}^{-\theta}(1-\cos2t)\,dt=2a^{2}\left(-\theta+\frac{1}{2}\sin2\theta\right)\end{aligned} 
$$
代入得：
$$
 \iint_{D}\frac{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}{\sqrt{4a^{2}-x^{2}-y^{2}}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=2a^{2}\int_{-\frac{\pi}{4}}^{0}\left(-\theta+\frac{1}{2}\sin2\theta\right)\mathrm{d}\theta=\left(\frac{\pi^{2}}{16}-\frac{1}{2}\right)a^{2} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设平面区域 $ D = \{(x, y) \mid x + y \leqslant 1, x \geqslant 0, y \geqslant 0\} $，计算 $ \iint_{D} \frac{e^{-(x+y)}}{\sqrt{xy}} \, \mathrm{d}\sigma. $
explanationMarkdown:
**方法一（极坐标）**：
$$
 \begin{aligned} 原式 &=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}}\frac{\mathrm{e}^{-r(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)}}{\sqrt{\cos\theta\sin\theta}}\mathrm{d}r\\ &=\left(1-\frac{1}{\mathrm{e}}\right)\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{1}{(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)\sqrt{\cos\theta\sin\theta}}\mathrm{d}\theta\\ &=\left(1-\frac{1}{\mathrm{e}}\right)\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{\mathrm{d}\theta}{\cos^{2}\theta(1+\tan\theta)\sqrt{\tan\theta}}\\ &=\left(1-\frac{1}{\mathrm{e}}\right)\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{\mathrm{d}(\tan\theta)}{(1+\tan\theta)\sqrt{\tan\theta}}\\ &\xlongequal{\tan\theta=u}\left(1-\frac{1}{\mathrm{e}}\right)\int_{0}^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{(1+u)\sqrt{u}}\\ &=2\left(1-\frac{1}{\mathrm{e}}\right)\int_{0}^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{d}(\sqrt{u})}{1+(\sqrt{u})^{2}}\\ &=2\left(1-\frac{1}{\mathrm{e}}\right)\cdot\arctan\sqrt{u}\bigg|_{0}^{+\infty}\\ &=\pi\left(1-\frac{1}{\mathrm{e}}\right).\end{aligned} 
$$
**方法二（换元法）**：
令 $ u=-(x+y), v=x $，雅可比行列式为 $ 1 $，区域 $ D' $ 为 $ -1\leq u\leq0, 0\leq v\leq -u $。
$$
 \begin{aligned} 原式 &=\iint_{D'}\frac{\mathrm{e}^{u}}{\sqrt{v(-v-u)}}\mathrm{d}u\mathrm{d}v=\int_{-1}^{0}\mathrm{d}u\int_{0}^{-u}\frac{\mathrm{e}^{u}}{\sqrt{-v^{2}-uv}}\mathrm{d}v\\ &=\int_{-1}^{0}\mathrm{e}^{u}\left(\arcsin\frac{v+\frac{u}{2}}{-\frac{u}{2}}\right)\Bigg|_{0}^{-u}\mathrm{d}u\\ &=\int_{-1}^{0}\pi\mathrm{e}^{u}\mathrm{d}u=\pi\left(1-\frac{1}{\mathrm{e}}\right).\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设平面区域 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid |x|+|y|\leq1\right\} $，求 $ \iint_{D}e^{\frac{|y|}{|x|+|y|}}d\sigma $。
explanationMarkdown:
【解析】将 $D$ 分成第一，二，三，四象限中的 4 块，分别记为 $ D_{1}, D_{2}, D_{3}, D_{4} $，用极坐标，先对 $ D_{1} $ 进行积分：
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D_{1}}\mathrm{e}^{\frac{|y|}{|x|+|y|}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{\sin\theta+\cos\theta}}\mathrm{e}^{\frac{\sin\theta}{|\sin\theta|+\cos\theta}}r\mathrm{d}r\\&=\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{e}^{\frac{\sin\theta}{|\sin\theta|+\cos\theta}}\cdot\frac{1}{(\sin\theta+\cos\theta)^{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{e}^{\frac{\sin\theta}{|\sin\theta|+\cos\theta}}\mathrm{d}\left(\frac{\sin\theta}{|\sin\theta|+\cos\theta}\right)\\&=\frac{1}{2}\mathrm{e}^{\frac{\sin\theta}{|\sin\theta|+\cos\theta}}\bigg|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}=\frac{1}{2}(\mathrm{e}-1).\end{aligned} 
$$
 
根据对称性，被积函数关于 $x$, $y$ 均为偶函数，且积分区域关于 $y$ 轴，$x$ 轴对称，故
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}\mathrm{e}^{\frac{|y|}{|x|+|y|}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=4\iint_{D_{1}}\mathrm{e}^{\frac{|y|}{|x|+|y|}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&=4\times\frac{1}{2}(\mathrm{e}-1)\\&=2(\mathrm{e}-1).\end{aligned} 
$$
 
【详解二】令 $ u = x, v = x + y $，则 $ x = u, y = v - u $， $ D' = \{(u, v) \mid 0 \leq u \leq v \leq 1\} $，
$$
 \begin{aligned}J&=\begin{vmatrix}{{{\frac{\partial x}{\partial u}}}}&{{{\frac{\partial x}{\partial v}}}} \\{{{\frac{\partial y}{\partial u}}}}&{{{\frac{\partial y}{\partial v}}}}\end{vmatrix}=\begin{vmatrix}{{{1}}}&{{{0}}} \\{{{-1}}}&{{{1}}}\end{vmatrix}=1, \end{aligned} 
$$
 
$$
 \iint\limits_{D}e^{\frac{|y|}{|x|+|y|}}dxdy=4\iint\limits_{D_{1}}e^{\frac{x}{x+y}}dxdy=4\iint\limits_{D'}e^{\frac{u}{v}}\left|J\right|dudv=4\int_{0}^{1}dv\int_{0}^{v}e^{\frac{u}{v}}du=4(e-1)\int_{0}^{1}vdv=2(e-1) 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设区域 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x+y\leqslant1,x\geqslant0,y\geqslant0\right\} $，计算积分 $ \iint_{D}\cos\frac{x-y}{x+y}dxdy $。
explanationMarkdown:
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}\cos\frac{x-y}{x+y}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{\sin\theta+\cos\theta}}\cos\frac{\cos\theta-\sin\theta}{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}\cdot r\mathrm{d}r\\&=\frac{1}{2}\cdot\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\cos\frac{\cos\theta-\sin\theta}{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}\cdot\frac{1}{(\sin\theta+\cos\theta)^{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=-\frac{1}{4}\cdot\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\cos\frac{\cos\theta-\sin\theta}{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}\mathrm{d}\left(\frac{\cos\theta-\sin\theta}{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}\right)\\&=\frac{1}{4}\cdot\sin\frac{\cos\theta-\sin\theta}{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}\bigg|_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{0}=\frac{1}{2}\sin1.\end{aligned} 
$$
 
【详解二】令 $ u=x+y $， $ v=x-y $，则 $ x=\frac{u+v}{2} $， $ y=\frac{u-v}{2} $， $ D'=\left\{(u,v)\mid0\leq|v|\leq u\leq1\right\} $
$$
 \begin{aligned}J&=\begin{vmatrix}\frac{\partial x}{\partial u}&\frac{\partial x}{\partial v}\\\frac{\partial y}{\partial u}&\frac{\partial y}{\partial v}\end{vmatrix}=-\frac{1}{2}, \end{aligned} 
$$
 
$$
 \iint_{D}\cos\frac{x-y}{x+y}dxdy=\iint_{D'}\cos\frac{v}{u}\Big|J\Big|dudv=\int_{0}^{1}du\int_{0}^{u}\cos\frac{v}{u}dv=\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{1}u\sin\frac{v}{u}\bigg|_{v=0}^{v=u}du=\sin1\int_{0}^{1}udu=\frac{1}{2}\sin1 
$$

contentMarkdown: 计算二重积分 $ \iint_{D}\frac{x^{2}+y^{2}}{|x|+|y|}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y $，其中 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid1\leqslant|x|+|y|\leqslant2\right\} $。
explanationMarkdown:
【解析】设 $ D_{1} $ 是 $D$ 在第一象限的部分，则由对称性，得
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}\frac{x^{2}+y^{2}}{|x|+|y|}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=4\iint_{D_{1}}\frac{x^{2}+y^{2}}{x+y}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=4\iint_{D_{1}}\frac{r^{2}}{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}\mathrm{d}r\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=4\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{\frac{1}{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}}^{\frac{2}{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}}\frac{r^{2}}{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}\mathrm{d}r\\&=\frac{28}{3}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{1}{(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)^{4}}\mathrm{d}\theta\end{aligned} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}&=\frac{7}{3}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{1}{\sin^{4}\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)}\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=\frac{7}{3}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\csc^{4}\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=-\frac{7}{3}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\left[\cot^{2}\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)+1\right]\mathrm{d}\left[\cot\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)\right]\\&=-\frac{7}{3}\left[\frac{1}{3}\cot^{3}\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)+\cot\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)\right]\bigg|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}=\frac{56}{9}.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid0\leqslant x\leqslant1,0\leqslant y\leqslant1\right\} $，则 $ \iint_{D}\frac{\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}= $ ___.
explanationMarkdown:
在第一象限单位正方形内使用极坐标。区域可分为
$$
0\leqslant\theta\leqslant\frac{\pi}{4},\ 0\leqslant r\leqslant\sec\theta,
$$
与
$$
\frac{\pi}{4}\leqslant\theta\leqslant\frac{\pi}{2},\ 0\leqslant r\leqslant\csc\theta.
$$
因此
$$
\iint_D\frac{\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}}=\int_0^{\pi/4}\sec\theta\,\mathrm{d}\theta+\int_{\pi/4}^{\pi/2}\csc\theta\,\mathrm{d}\theta=2\ln(1+\sqrt{2}).
$$

contentMarkdown: 设区域 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid0\leqslant x\leqslant2,0\leqslant y\leqslant2\right\} $，计算积分 $ \iint_{D}\frac{1}{\left(4+x^{2}+y^{2}\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}}dxdy. $
explanationMarkdown:
【详解】 $ D_{1}=\left\{(x,y)\mid0\leqslant x\leqslant2,0\leqslant y\leqslant x\right\},D_{2}=\left\{(x,y)\mid0\leqslant x\leqslant y,0\leqslant y\leqslant2\right\} $ 由于区域 D 关于 y = x 对称，则 
$$
 \begin{aligned} 原式 &=2\iint_{D_{1}}\frac{\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y}{(4+x^{2}+y^{2})^{\frac{3}{2}}}=2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2\sec\theta}\frac{r\mathrm{d}r}{(4+r^{2})^{\frac{3}{2}}}\xrightarrow{ Ⅱ }+\sqrt{5}dx\int_{0}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}y&\\ &=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2\sec\theta}\frac{1}{(4+r^{2})^{\frac{3}{2}}}\mathrm{d}(4+r^{2})=-2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\frac{1}{\sqrt{4+r^{2}}}\bigg|_{0}^{2\sec\theta}\mathrm{d}\theta\\ &=2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\left(\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{\sqrt{4+4\sec^{2}\theta}}\right)\mathrm{d}\theta=\frac{\pi}{4}-\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\frac{\cos\theta}{\sqrt{1+\cos^{2}\theta}}\mathrm{d}\theta\\ &\\ &=\frac{\pi}{4}-\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\frac{1}{\sqrt{2-\sin^{2}\theta}}\mathrm{d}(\sin\theta)\\ &\\ &=\left.\frac{\pi}{4}-\arcsin\frac{\sin\theta}{\sqrt{2}}\right|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}=\frac{\pi}{12}.\\ \end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leq1\right\} $，则 $ \iint_{D}(x^{2}-y)dxdy= $ ___。
explanationMarkdown:
【答案】 $ \frac{\pi}{4} $ 【解】 方法一 由对称性得 
$$
 \iint_{D}^{}(x^{2}-y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint_{D}^{}x^{2}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\frac{1}{2}\iint_{D}^{}(x^{2}+y^{2})\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{1}r^{3}\mathrm{d}r=\frac{\pi}{4} 
$$
 方法二 由奇偶性得 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}(x^{2}-y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=&\iint_{D}x^{2}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\int_{0}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{1}r^{3}\cos^{2}\theta\mathrm{d}r\\=&\frac{1}{4}\int_{0}^{2\pi}\cos^{2}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta=\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{\pi}\cos^{2}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\cos^{2}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta=\frac{1}{2}\times\frac{\pi}{2}=\frac{\pi}{4}.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设平面区域 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant1\right\} $，则 $ \iint_{D}(x-2y)^{2}dxdy= $ ___。
explanationMarkdown:
11.【答案】 $ \frac{5}{4}\pi $ 【解析】 
$$
 \iint\limits_{D}(x-2y)^{2}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint\limits_{D}(x^{2}+4y^{2}-4xy)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y. 
$$
 由于在区域 D 上，4xy 为 x 的奇函数，区域 D 关于 y 轴对称，因此 $ \iint_{D}(-4xy)dxdy=0. $ 所以 
$$
 \iint_{D}(x-2y)^{2}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint_{D}(x^{2}+4y^{2})\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y. 
$$
 由于区域 D 中交换 x 与 y 的位置 D 不变，因此 
$$
 I=\iint\limits_{D}(x^{2}+4y^{2})\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint\limits_{D}(y^{2}+4x^{2})\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y, 
$$
 即 
$$
 \begin{aligned}2I=&\iint\limits_{D}\left[(x^{2}+4y^{2})+(y^{2}+4x^{2})\right]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\=&\iint\limits_{D}(x^{2}+y^{2})\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=5\int_{0}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{1}r^{2}\cdot r\mathrm{d}r=\frac{5}{4}\cdot2\pi=\frac{5}{2}\pi.\end{aligned} 
$$
 故 $ I=\frac{5}{4}\pi. $ 【注】本题也可以不用如上技巧，而直接用极坐标求解如下.先用极坐标，再用华里士公式，有 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}(x-2y)^{2}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=\int_{0}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{1}(r\cos\theta-2r\sin\theta)^{2}r\mathrm{d}r\\&=\int_{0}^{2\pi}(\cos^{2}\theta-4\cos\theta\sin\theta+4\sin^{2}\theta)\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{1}r^{3}\mathrm{d}r\\&=\frac{1}{4}\int_{0}^{2\pi}(\cos^{2}\theta-4\cos\theta\sin\theta+4\sin^{2}\theta)\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=\frac{1}{4}\left(4\cdot\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{\pi}{2}-\frac{4}{2}\cdot0+4\cdot4\cdot\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{\pi}{2}\right)\\&=\frac{5}{4}\pi.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设平面区域 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant4,x\leqslant0\right\} $，求 $ \iint_{D}(1+|x|+xy)\sqrt{4-x^{2}-y^{2}}dx dy $。
explanationMarkdown:
31.【解析】由于积分区域 D 关于 x 轴对称（见图），且 $ x \leqslant 0 $，故 
$$
 \begin{aligned}&\iint\limits_{D}(1+\mid x\mid+xy)\sqrt{4-x^{2}-y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\=&\iint\limits_{D}(1-x)\sqrt{4-x^{2}-y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\=&\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{3}{2}\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2}(1-r\cos\theta)\sqrt{4-r^{2}}\cdot r\mathrm{d}r,\end{aligned} 
$$
 其中 
$$
 \begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{2}(1-r\cos\theta)\sqrt{4-r^{2}}\cdot r\mathrm{d}r\\=&\int_{0}^{2}r\sqrt{4-r^{2}}\mathrm{d}r-\cos\theta\int_{0}^{2}r^{2}\sqrt{4-r^{2}}\mathrm{d}r\\=&-\frac{1}{3}(4-r^{2})^{\frac{3}{2}}\bigg|_{0}^{2}-\cos\theta\bigg[\frac{r}{8}(2r^{2}-4)\sqrt{4-r^{2}}+2\arcsin\frac{r}{2}\bigg]\bigg|_{0}^{2}\\=&\frac{8}{3}-\pi\cdot\cos\theta,\end{aligned} 
$$
 故 
$$
 \begin{aligned}&\iint_{D}(1+\mid x\mid+xy)\sqrt{4-x^{2}-y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{3}{2}\pi}\left(\frac{8}{3}-\pi\cdot\cos\theta\right)\mathrm{d}\theta\\ &=\left.\frac{8}{3}\pi-\pi\cdot\sin\theta\right|_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{3}{2}\pi}=\frac{14}{3}\pi.\\ \end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设区域 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant1,x\geqslant0\right\} $，计算二重积分 $ I=\iint_{D}\frac{1+xy}{1+x^{2}+y^{2}}dxdy. $
设 $ D: x^{2} + y^{2} \leqslant 1, x \geqslant 0, y \geqslant 0 $，则 $ I = \iint_{D} \frac{1 + x - y}{1 + x^{2} + y^{2}} \, \mathrm{d}x \, \mathrm{d}y = $ ___
explanationMarkdown:
解 如图 5-9 所示，由于 D 关于直线 y = x 对称，所以 
$$
 \begin{aligned}I&=\iint_{D}\frac{1+x-y}{1+x^{2}+y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&=\frac{1}{2}\iint_{D}\left(\frac{1+x-y}{1+x^{2}+y^{2}}+\frac{1+y-x}{1+y^{2}+x^{2}}\right)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&=\frac{1}{2}\iint_{D}\frac{2}{1+x^{2}+y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{1}\frac{r}{1+r^{2}}\mathrm{d}r\\&=\frac{\pi}{2}\cdot\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{1}\frac{\mathrm{d}(1+r^{2})}{1+r^{2}}=\frac{\pi}{4}\ln(1+r^{2})\bigg|_{0}^{1}=\frac{\pi}{4}\ln2.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设区域 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leq1,y\geq0\right\} $，计算二重积分 $ \iint_{D}\frac{1+y+y\ln(x+\sqrt{1+x^{2}})}{1+x^{2}+y^{2}}dxdy $
设平面区域D由直线y=x,y=-x,y=1与y=2围成.计算二重积分 $ I=\iint_{D}\frac{1+xy}{x^{2}+y^{2}}dxdy. $
explanationMarkdown:
区域 $D$ 关于 $y$ 轴对称，而 $\dfrac{xy}{x^2+y^2}$ 关于 $x$ 为奇函数，所以 
$$
\iint_D\frac{xy}{x^2+y^2}\,dxdy=0.
$$
 因此只需计算 
$$
I=\iint_D\frac{1}{x^2+y^2}\,dxdy.
$$
 用极坐标，区域为 
$$
\frac\pi4\le\theta\le\frac{3\pi}{4},\qquad \frac1{\sin\theta}\le r\le\frac2{\sin\theta}.
$$
 于是 
$$
I=\int_{\pi/4}^{3\pi/4}\int_{1/\sin\theta}^{2/\sin\theta}\frac1{r^2}r\,drd\theta=\int_{\pi/4}^{3\pi/4}\ln2\,d\theta=\frac\pi2\ln2.
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $D$ 是由直线 $y=1$, $y=\frac{1}{2}x$, $y=-\frac{1}{2}x$ 围成的有界区域，计算二重积分 $\iint_{D}\frac{x^{2}-3xy-4y^{2}}{x^{2}+4y^{2}}dxdy$。
explanationMarkdown:
由于积分区域 $D$ 关于 $y$ 轴对称，而 $\frac{xy}{x^{2}+4y^{2}}$ 是关于 $x$ 的奇函数，故 $\iint_{D}\frac{xy}{x^{2}+4y^{2}}dxdy=0$。记原积分为 $I$，则 $I=\iint\limits_{D}\frac{x^{2}-4y^{2}}{x^{2}+4y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint\limits_{D}\Big(1-\frac{8y^{2}}{x^{2}+4y^{2}}\Big)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$。区域 $D$ 为由直线 $y = 1$, $y = \frac{1}{2}x$, $y = -\frac{1}{2}x$ 围成的三角形区域，该三角形的底为 $4$，高为 $1$，面积等于 $\frac{1}{2} \times 4 \times 1 = 2$。从而，$I=2-8\iint\limits_{D}\frac{y^{2}}{x^{2}+4y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\xlongequal{对称性}2-16\iint\limits_{D_{1}}\frac{y^{2}}{x^{2}+4y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$，其中 $D_{1}$ 是区域 $D$ 位于第一象限的部分。把 $D_{1}$ 看作 $Y$ 型区域，$D_{1} = \left\{ (x, y) \mid 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 2y, 0 \leqslant y \leqslant 1 \right\}$。 
$$
\begin{aligned}\iint_{D_{1}}\frac{y^{2}}{x^{2}+4y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=\int_{0}^{1}y^{2}\mathrm{d}y\int_{0}^{2y}\frac{1}{x^{2}+4y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\xlongequal{u=\frac{x}{y}}\int_{0}^{1}y^{2}\cdot\frac{1}{y}\mathrm{d}y\int_{0}^{2}\frac{1}{u^{2}+4}\mathrm{d}u\\&=\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{2}\frac{1}{\left(\frac{u}{2}\right)^{2}+1}\mathrm{d}\left(\frac{u}{2}\right)=\left.\frac{1}{4}\arctan\frac{u}{2}\right|_{0}^{2}\\&=\frac{1}{4}\cdot\frac{\pi}{4}=\frac{\pi}{16}.\end{aligned}
$$
 因此，$I = 2 - 16 \cdot \frac{\pi}{16} = 2 - \pi$。也可以在极坐标系下计算 $\iint_{D_{1}}\frac{y^{2}}{x^{2}+4y^{2}}dxdy$。在极坐标系下，$x=r\cos\theta$, $y=r\sin\theta$，直线 $y=1$ 对应 $r=\frac{1}{\sin\theta}$。区域 $D_{1}$ 的极坐标表示为 $D_{1}=\left\{(r,\theta)\mid0\leqslant r\leqslant\frac{1}{\sin\theta},\arctan\frac{1}{2}\leqslant\theta\leqslant\frac{\pi}{2}\right\}$。因此， 
$$
\begin{aligned}\iint_{D_{1}}\frac{y^{2}}{x^{2}+4y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=\iint_{D_{1}}\frac{r^{2}\sin^{2}\theta}{r^{2}\cos^{2}\theta+4r^{2}\sin^{2}\theta}\cdot r\mathrm{d}r\mathrm{d}\theta=\int_{\arctan\frac{1}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{\sin^{2}\theta}{\cos^{2}\theta+4\sin^{2}\theta}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{\sin\theta}}r\mathrm{d}r\\&=\frac{1}{2}\int_{\arctan\frac{1}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{1}{\cos^{2}\theta+4\sin^{2}\theta}\mathrm{d}\theta=\frac{1}{2}\int_{\arctan\frac{1}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{1}{1+4\tan^{2}\theta}\mathrm{d}(\tan\theta)\\&\xlongequal{u=\tan\theta}\frac{1}{2}\int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{+\infty}\frac{1}{1+4u^{2}}\mathrm{d}u=\frac{1}{4}\int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{+\infty}\frac{1}{1+(2u)^{2}}\mathrm{d}(2u)\\&=\frac{1}{4}\arctan2u\Big|_{\frac{1}{2}}^{+\infty}=\frac{1}{4}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\frac{\pi}{4}\right)=\frac{\pi}{16}.\end{aligned}
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $D$ 是由 $y = |x|$ 及 $y = 1$ 围成的有界区域，计算二重积分 $\iint_{D}\frac{x^{2}-x\cos y-y^{2}}{x^{2}+y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$。
explanationMarkdown:
由对称性，得 
$$
\begin{aligned}\iint_{D}\frac{x^{2}-x\cos y-y^{2}}{x^{2}+y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&= \iint_{D}\frac{x^{2}-y^{2}}{x^{2}+y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=2\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{\sin\theta}}\frac{r^{2}\cos^{2}\theta-r^{2}\sin^{2}\theta}{r^{2}}r\mathrm{d}r\\&= \int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(\cos^{2}\theta-\sin^{2}\theta)\frac{1}{\sin^{2}\theta}\mathrm{d}\theta=\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\cot^{2}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta-\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}1\mathrm{d}\theta\\&= \int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\csc^{2}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta-\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}2\mathrm{d}\theta=-\cot\theta\Big|_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}-\frac{\pi}{2}=1-\frac{\pi}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

contentMarkdown: 设区域 $D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant1,x+y\geqslant0\right\}$，计算积分 $\iint_{D}\frac{1+2x^{2}+xy^{2}}{1+x^{2}+y^{2}}dxdy$。
explanationMarkdown:
用直线 $y = x$ 将 $D$ 分割为 $D_{1} = D_{11} \cup D_{12}$，$D_{2}$，其中 $D_{1}$ 关于 $x$ 轴对称，$D_{2}$ 关于 $y$ 轴对称。则 $\iint_{D}\frac{xy^{2}}{1+x^{2}+y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint_{D_{1}}\frac{xy^{2}}{1+x^{2}+y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint_{D_{2}}\frac{xy^{2}}{1+x^{2}+y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=2\iint_{D_{12}}\frac{xy^{2}}{1+x^{2}+y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$。 
$$
\begin{aligned}&y=x \Rightarrow 2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{1}\frac{r^{3}\cos\theta\sin^{2}\theta}{1+r^{2}}r\mathrm{d}r=2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin^{2}\theta\cos\theta\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{1}\frac{r^{4}-1}{1+r^{2}}\mathrm{d}r\\&\quad =2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin^{2}\theta\mathrm{d}\sin\theta\int_{0}^{1}\left(r^{2}-1+\frac{1}{1+r^{2}}\right)\mathrm{d}r=\frac{1}{3\sqrt{2}}\Big(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{2}{3}\Big).\end{aligned}
$$
 $\iint_{D}\frac{1+2x^{2}}{1+x^{2}+y^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\frac{1}{2}\iint_{D}\left(\frac{1+2x^{2}}{1+x^{2}+y^{2}}+\frac{1+2y^{2}}{1+x^{2}+y^{2}}\right)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint_{D}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\frac{\pi}{2}$。因此，$\iint_D\frac{1+2x^2+xy^2}{1+x^2+y^2}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\frac{\pi}{2}+\frac{1}{3\sqrt{2}}\Big(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{2}{3}\Big)$。

contentMarkdown: 计算二重积分 $ \iint_{D}\frac{x\sin(\pi\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}})}{x+y}dxdy $，其中 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid1\leq x^{2}+y^{2}\leq4,x\geq0,y\geq0\right\} $.
explanationMarkdown:
解法1（极坐标）：令 $ x = r\cos\theta, y = r\sin\theta $，则 $ D = \{(r,\theta) \mid 1 \leq r \leq 2, 0 \leq \theta \leq \frac{\pi}{2}\} $。原积分化为 $ I = \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} d\theta \int_{1}^{2} \frac{r\cos\theta \cdot \sin(\pi r)}{r(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)} \cdot r dr = \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{\cos\theta}{\cos\theta+\sin\theta} d\theta \int_{1}^{2} r \sin(\pi r) dr $。分别计算：$ I_1 = \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{\cos\theta}{\cos\theta+\sin\theta} d\theta = \frac{\pi}{4} $，$ I_2 = \int_{1}^{2} r \sin(\pi r) dr = -\frac{3}{\pi} $。故 $ I = I_1 \times I_2 = \frac{\pi}{4} \times (-\frac{3}{\pi}) = -\frac{3}{4} $。
解法2（轮换对称性）：由区域 $ D $ 关于 $ y=x $ 对称，有 $ \iint_{D} \frac{x \sin(\pi \sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}})}{x+y} dxdy = \iint_{D} \frac{y \sin(\pi \sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}})}{x+y} dxdy $。两式相加得 $ I = \frac{1}{2} \iint_{D} \sin(\pi \sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}) dxdy $。化为极坐标：$ I = \frac{1}{2} \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} d\theta \int_{1}^{2} \sin(\pi r) \cdot r dr = \frac{\pi}{4} \times (-\frac{3}{\pi}) = -\frac{3}{4} $。

contentMarkdown: 设平面区域 $ D = \left\{(x, y) \mid 1 \leqslant x^{2} + y^{2} \leqslant 4, x \geqslant 0, y \geqslant 0\right\} $。计算 $ \iint_{D} \frac{x \ln(x^{2} + y^{2})}{x + y} \, \mathrm{d}x \, \mathrm{d}y $。
explanationMarkdown:
解法1（轮换对称性）：由于积分区域 $ D $ 关于 $ y=x $ 对称，故 $ \iint_{D} \frac{x \ln(x^{2}+y^{2})}{x+y} dxdy = \iint_{D} \frac{y \ln(x^{2}+y^{2})}{x+y} dxdy $。两式相加得 $ I = \frac{1}{2} \iint_{D} \ln(x^{2}+y^{2}) dxdy $。在极坐标系下，$ D = \{(r,\theta) \mid 1 \leqslant r \leqslant 2, 0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant \frac{\pi}{2}\} $，则 $ I = \frac{1}{2} \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} d\theta \int_{1}^{2} \ln r^{2} \cdot r dr = \frac{\pi}{2} \int_{1}^{2} r \ln r dr $。计算 $ \int_{1}^{2} r \ln r dr = 2\ln2 - \frac{3}{4} $。因此 $ I = \frac{\pi}{2} \cdot (2\ln2 - \frac{3}{4}) = \frac{\pi}{8}(8\ln2 - 3) $。
解法2（直接极坐标）：$ I = \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} d\theta \int_{1}^{2} \frac{r\cos\theta \ln r^{2}}{r(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)} \cdot r dr = 2 \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{\cos\theta}{\cos\theta+\sin\theta} d\theta \int_{1}^{2} r \ln r dr $。计算 $ \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{\cos\theta}{\cos\theta+\sin\theta} d\theta = \frac{\pi}{4} $，$ \int_{1}^{2} r \ln r dr = 2\ln2 - \frac{3}{4} $。故 $ I = 2 \times \frac{\pi}{4} \times (2\ln2 - \frac{3}{4}) = \frac{\pi}{8}(8\ln2 - 3) $。

contentMarkdown: 设平面区域 $ D = \{(x, y) \mid 1 \leqslant x^{2} + y^{2} \leqslant 4, x \geqslant 0, y \geqslant 0\} $，计算 $ \iint_{D}\frac{x\cos\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}{x+y}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y $。
explanationMarkdown: 由轮换对称性，得 $ \iint_{D}\frac{x\cos\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}{x+y}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y = \iint_{D}\frac{y\cos\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}{x+y}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y $。两式相加得 $ I = \frac{1}{2} \iint_{D} \cos\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}} \mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y $。在极坐标系下，$ D = \{(r,\theta) \mid 1 \leqslant r \leqslant 2, 0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant \frac{\pi}{2}\} $，则 $ I = \frac{1}{2} \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \mathrm{d}\theta \int_{1}^{2} r\cos r \mathrm{d}r = \frac{\pi}{4} \int_{1}^{2} r\cos r \mathrm{d}r $。计算 $ \int_{1}^{2} r\cos r \mathrm{d}r = (r\sin r + \cos r)\big|_{1}^{2} = (2\sin2 + \cos2) - (\sin1 + \cos1) $。因此 $ I = \frac{\pi}{4}(2\sin2 + \cos2 - \sin1 - \cos1) $。

contentMarkdown: 设二元函数 $f(x,y)=\left\{\begin{aligned}&x^{2},&|x|+|y|\leqslant1,\\&\frac{1}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}},&1\lt |x|+|y|\leqslant2,\end{aligned}\right.$ 计算二重积分 $\iint_{D}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}\sigma$，其中 $D=\{(x,y)\mid |x|+|y|\leqslant2\}$。
explanationMarkdown:
令 $D_{1}=\left\{(x,y)\mid x+y\leqslant1,x\geqslant0,y\geqslant0\right\}$，$D_{2}=\left\{(x,y)\mid1\leqslant x+y\leqslant2,x\geqslant0,y\geqslant0\right\}$，$I=4\left(\iint\limits_{D_{1}}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint\limits_{D_{2}}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\right)$，$\iint_{D_{1}}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{1-x}x^{2}\mathrm{d}y=\int_{0}^{1}x^{2}(1-x)\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{12}$，
$$
\begin{aligned}\iint_{D_{2}}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{\frac{1}{\sin\theta+\cos\theta}}^{\frac{2}{\sin\theta+\cos\theta}}\frac{r}{r}\mathrm{d}r=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{1}{\sin\theta+\cos\theta}\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\csc\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)\mathrm{d}\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)\\&=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\ln\left|\csc\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)-\cot\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)\right|\bigg|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\\&=\sqrt{2}\ln(1+\sqrt{2}),\end{aligned}
$$
 故 $I=\frac{1}{3}+4\sqrt{2}\ln(1+\sqrt{2})$。

contentMarkdown: 已知函数 $f(x)=\begin{cases}e^{x}, & 0\leq x\leq1, \\ 0, & \text{其他},\end{cases}$ 则 $\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}dx\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}f(x)f(y-x)dy= $ ___.
explanationMarkdown:
根据 $f(x)$ 的定义，$f(x)$ 仅在 $0 \leqslant x \leqslant 1$ 时非零，$f(y-x)$ 仅在 $0 \leqslant y-x \leqslant 1$ 时非零。于是，$f(x)f(y-x)$ 仅在区域 $D = \{(x,y) \mid 0 \leqslant y-x \leqslant 1, 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 1\}$，即 $D = \{(x,y) \mid x \leqslant y \leqslant x + 1, 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 1\}$ 上非零。
$$
\begin{aligned}\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}\mathrm{d}x\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}f(x)f(y-x)\mathrm{d}y&=\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{d}x\int_{x}^{x+1}\mathrm{e}^{x}\mathrm{e}^{y-x}\mathrm{d}y=\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{d}x\int_{x}^{x+1}\mathrm{e}^{y}\mathrm{d}y\\&=\int_{0}^{1}\left(\mathrm{e}^{x+1}-\mathrm{e}^{x}\right)\mathrm{d}x=\left(\mathrm{e}^{x+1}-\mathrm{e}^{x}\right)\Bigg|_{0}^{1}\\&=\left(\mathrm{e}^{2}-\mathrm{e}\right)-\left(\mathrm{e}-1\right)=\mathrm{e}^{2}-2\mathrm{e}+1.\end{aligned}
$$

contentMarkdown: 已知 $f(x)=\begin{cases}e^{x}, & 0\leqslant x\leqslant1, \\ 0, & \text{其他},\end{cases}$，则 $\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}dx\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}f(y)f(x-y)dy= $ ___.
explanationMarkdown:
由题可知，当 $x, y$ 满足 $\left\{\begin{aligned}0&\leqslant y\leqslant1,\\ 0&\leqslant x-y\leqslant1\end{aligned}\right.$ 时，所求积分的被积函数才不为零，故 
$$
\text{原式} =\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{d}y\int_{y}^{y+1}\mathrm{e}^{x}\mathrm{d}x=\int_{0}^{1}(\mathrm{e}^{y+1}-\mathrm{e}^{y})\mathrm{d}y=\left.\mathrm{e}^{y+1}\right|_{0}^{1}-\left.\mathrm{e}^{y}\right|_{0}^{1}=(\mathrm{e}-1)^{2}.
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $f(x)=\begin{cases}x,-1\leq x\leq2\\0,\text{其他}\end{cases}$，$D$ 表示全平面，则 $\iint_{D}f(x)f(x^{2}-y)d\sigma= $ ___.
explanationMarkdown:
$f(x^{2}-y)=\left\{\begin{array}{l}x^{2}-y,x^{2}-2\leq y\leq x^{2}+1\\0, \text{其他} \end{array}\right.$，$f(x)f(x^{2}-y)=\begin{cases}x(x^{2}-y),-1\leq x\leq2,x^{2}-2\leq y\leq x^{2}+1\\0,\text{其他}\end{cases}$，
$$
I=\int_{-1}^{2}x d x\int_{x^{2}-2}^{x^{2}+1}(x^{2}-y)d y =\frac{3}{2}\int_{-1}^{2}x d x=\frac{9}{4}.
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $f(x,y)=\left\{\begin{aligned}&x^{2}y,1\leq x\leq2,0\leq y\leq x\\ &0,\text{其他}\end{aligned}\right.$，区域 $D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\geq2x\right\}$，则 $\iint_{D}f(x,y)dxdy= $ ___.

设 $ f(x,y)=\left\{\begin{aligned}&\frac{1}{\left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right)^{2}}&1\leqslant x\leqslant3,\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}x\leqslant y\leqslant x\\&0,& 其他 \end{aligned}\right. $，$ D $ 由 $ x=3 $, $ x=1 $, $ y=0 $, $ y=3 $ 所围，计算 $ I=\iint\limits_{D}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y $。
explanationMarkdown:
函数非零区域为
$$
1\le x\le3,\;\frac{\sqrt3}{3}x\le y\le x.
$$
在极坐标中，对应
$$
\frac{\pi}{6}\le\theta\le\frac{\pi}{4},\;\sec\theta\le r\le3\sec\theta.
$$
因此
$$
\begin{aligned}I&=\int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/4}\int_{\sec\theta}^{3\sec\theta}\frac1{r^4}\,r\,\mathrm{d}r\,\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=\int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/4}\left[-\frac{1}{2r^2}\right]_{\sec\theta}^{3\sec\theta}\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=\frac49\int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/4}\cos^2\theta\,\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=\frac29\int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/4}(1+\cos2\theta)\,\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=\frac{\pi+6-3\sqrt3}{54}.\end{aligned}
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ f(x)=\left\{\begin{aligned}&x,&0\leqslant x\leqslant1,\\ &0,& 其他 \end{aligned}\right. $，$ D:-\infty \lt x \lt +\infty,-\infty \lt y \lt +\infty $，则 $ I=\iint_{D}f(y)f(x+y)dxdy= $
explanationMarkdown:
由已知，有
$$
 f(y)=\begin{cases}y,&0\leqslant y\leqslant1,\\0,& 其他 ,\end{cases} 
$$
$$
 f(x+y)=\begin{cases}x+y,&0\leqslant x+y\leqslant1,\\0,& 其他 ,\end{cases} 
$$
故 $ D_{1}=\left\{(x,y)\mid-y\leqslant x\leqslant1-y,0\leqslant y\leqslant1\right\} $，如图5-30所示。在 $ D_{1} $ 上 $ f(y)=y, f(x+y)=x+y $，在 $ D_{1} $ 以外部分 $ f(y)=0 $ 或 $ f(x+y)=0 $，故
$$
 \begin{aligned}I=&\iint_{D}f(y)f(x+y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint_{D_{1}}y(x+y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\=&\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{d}y\int_{-y}^{1-y}y(x+y)\mathrm{d}x=\int_{0}^{1}y\cdot\frac{1}{2}(x+y)^{2}\left|_{-y}^{1-y}\mathrm{d}y=\int_{0}^{1}\frac{1}{2}y\mathrm{d}y=\frac{1}{4}.\right.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 计算 $ \iint_{D} f(x,y) \, \mathrm{d}\sigma $，其中 $ D = \{(x,y) \mid x^{2} + y^{2} \geqslant 2x\} $，$ f(x,y)=\begin{cases}y,&1\leqslant x\leqslant2,0\leqslant y\leqslant x,\\0,& 其他 .\end{cases} $
explanationMarkdown:
被积函数 $ f(x,y) $ 的非零区域和积分区域的公共部分如图所示，故
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}\sigma&=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{2\cos\theta}^{\frac{2}{\cos\theta}}r\sin\theta\cdot r\mathrm{d}r\\&=\left.\frac{1}{3}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin\theta\cdot r^{3}\right|_{\substack{2\cos\theta}}^{\frac{2}{\cos\theta}}\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=\left.\frac{8}{3}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\left(\frac{\sin\theta}{\cos^{3}\theta}-\cos^{3}\theta\sin\theta\right)\mathrm{d}\theta\right.\\&=\left.\frac{8}{3}\left(\frac{1}{2}\ \frac{1}{\cos^{2}\theta}+\frac{1}{4}\cos^{4}\theta\right)\right|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\\&=\frac{5}{6}.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 已知平面区域 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid(x-1)^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant1\right\} $，计算二重积分 $ \iint_{D}\left|\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}-1\right|dxdy $。
explanationMarkdown:
改用极坐标，区域 $D$ 为
$$
-\frac{\pi}{2}\le\theta\le\frac{\pi}{2},\quad 0\le r\le2\cos\theta.
$$
被积函数为 $|r-1|$，面积元为 $r\,dr\,d\theta$。当 $|\theta|\le\pi/3$ 时需在 $r=1$ 处分段；当 $\pi/3\le|\theta|\le\pi/2$ 时有 $2\cos\theta\le1$。因此
$$
\begin{aligned}I&=2\int_0^{\pi/3}\left[\int_0^1(1-r)r\,dr+\int_1^{2\cos\theta}(r-1)r\,dr\right]d\theta\\&\quad+2\int_{\pi/3}^{\pi/2}\int_0^{2\cos\theta}(1-r)r\,dr\,d\theta\\&=3\sqrt3-\frac{\pi+32}{9}.\end{aligned}
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D: x^{2} + y^{2} \leqslant \sqrt{2}x, 0 \leqslant y \leqslant x $，计算 $ I = \iint_{D} \left| \sqrt{x^{2} + y^{2}} - 1 \right| \, dx \, dy $.
explanationMarkdown:
用 $ x^{2} + y^{2} = 1 $，即 $ r = 1 $ 将 $ D $ 划分为 $ D_{1} $ 与 $ D_{2} $，则 
$$
 \begin{aligned}I&=\iint_{\overline{D_{1}}}(1-r)r\mathrm{d}r\mathrm{d}\theta+\iint_{\overline{D_{2}}+\overline{D_{1}}}(r-1)r\mathrm{d}r\mathrm{d}\theta-\iint_{\overline{D_{1}}}(\mathrm{c}-\mathrm{r})\mathrm{d}\mathrm{r}\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=\iint_{\overline{D_{1}}}(1-r)r\mathrm{d}r\mathrm{d}\theta-\iint_{\overline{D_{2}}}(1-r)r\mathrm{d}r\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=2\iint_{\overline{D_{1}}}(1-r)r\mathrm{d}r\mathrm{d}\theta-\iint_{\overline{D}}(1-r)r\mathrm{d}r\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{1}(1-r)r\mathrm{d}r-\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{\sqrt{2}\cos\theta}(1-r)r\mathrm{d}r\\&=\frac{\pi}{12}-\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\left(\cos^{2}\theta-\frac{2\sqrt{2}}{3}\cos^{3}\theta\right)\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=\frac{\pi}{12}+\frac{5}{9}-\frac{1}{4}-\frac{\pi}{8}=\frac{11}{36}-\frac{\pi}{24}.\end{aligned} 
$$

explanationMarkdown:
用 $ x^{2} + y^{2} = 4 $ 将 $ D $ 划分为 $ D_{1} $ 与 $ D_{2} $，则 
$$
 \begin{aligned}I&=\iint_{D}^{}\left|x^{2}+y^{2}-4\right|\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\ &=-\iint_{D_{1}}^{}(x^{2}+y^{2}-4)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint_{D_{2}}^{}(x^{2}+y^{2}-4)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\ &=-\iint_{D_{1}}^{}(x^{2}+y^{2}-4)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint_{D-D_{1}}^{}(x^{2}+y^{2}-4)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\ &=\iint_{D}^{}(x^{2}+y^{2}-4)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y-2\iint_{D_{1}}^{}(x^{2}+y^{2}-4)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\ &=\int_{0}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{3}(r^{2}-4)r\mathrm{d}r-2\int_{0}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2}(r^{2}-4)r\mathrm{d}r\\ &=2\pi\left(\frac{r^{4}}{4}-2r^{2}\right)\bigg|_{0}^{3}-4\pi\left(\frac{r^{4}}{4}-2r^{2}\right)\bigg|_{0}^{2}\\ &=\frac{9}{2}\pi+16\pi=\frac{41}{2}\pi.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 计算二重积分 $ \iint_{D}\left|x^{2}+y^{2}-2y\right|dxdy $，其中 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leq4\right\} $.
explanationMarkdown:
在极坐标中，$x^{2}+y^{2}-2y=r^{2}-2r\sin\theta=r(r-2\sin\theta)$。圆 $r=2\sin\theta$ 把 $D:x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant4$ 中的符号分界给出。故
$$
I=\int_0^{2\pi}\int_0^2 r^2\cdot r\,\mathrm{d}r\mathrm{d}\theta-2\int_0^\pi\int_0^{2\sin\theta}(r^2-2r\sin\theta)r\,\mathrm{d}r\mathrm{d}\theta=8\pi+\frac{16}{3}\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^4\theta\,\mathrm{d}\theta=9\pi.
$$

contentMarkdown: 计算 $ \iint_{D}\sqrt{\left|y-x^{2}\right|}dxdy $ ，其中 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid-1\leq x\leq1,0\leq y\leq2\right\} $.
explanationMarkdown:
由对称性，
$$
I=2\int_0^1\left(\int_0^{x^2}\sqrt{x^2-y}\,\mathrm{d}y+\int_{x^2}^{2}\sqrt{y-x^2}\,\mathrm{d}y\right)\mathrm{d}x.
$$
内层积分得
$$
I=\frac{4}{3}\int_0^1\left[x^3+(2-x^2)^{3/2}\right]\mathrm{d}x=\frac13+\frac{4}{3}\int_0^1(2-x^2)^{3/2}\,\mathrm{d}x.
$$
令 $x=\sqrt2\sin t$，$0\leqslant t\leqslant\frac{\pi}{4}$，则后一个积分为 $4\int_0^{\pi/4}\cos^4t\,\mathrm{d}t=1+\frac{3\pi}{8}$。因此
$$
I=\frac13+\frac{4}{3}\left(1+\frac{3\pi}{8}\right)=\frac{\pi}{2}+\frac{5}{3}.
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D: |x| \leqslant 1, 0 \leqslant y \leqslant 2 $，计算 $ I = \iint_{D} |y - x^{2}| \, dx \, dy $.
explanationMarkdown:
由 $ y = x^{2} $ 将 $ D $ 划分为 $ D_{1} $ 与 $ D_{2} $，则 
$$
 \begin{aligned}I&=\iint_{D}\left|y-x^{2}\right|\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint_{D_{1}}(y-x^{2})\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint_{D_{2}}(x^{2}-y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&=\int_{-1}^{1}\mathrm{d}x\int_{x^{2}}^{2}(y-x^{2})\mathrm{d}y+\int_{-1}^{1}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{x^{2}}(x^{2}-y)\mathrm{d}y\\&=\int_{-1}^{1}\left.\frac{1}{2}(y-x^{2})^{2}\right|_{x^{2}}^{2}\mathrm{d}x-\int_{-1}^{1}\left.\frac{1}{2}(y-x^{2})^{2}\right|_{x^{2}}^{x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{2}\int_{-1}^{1}(4-4x^{2}+x^{4})\mathrm{d}x+\frac{1}{2}\int_{-1}^{1}x^{4}\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\int_{0}^{1}(2-2x^{2}+x^{4})\mathrm{d}x=2\times\left(2-\frac{2}{3}+\frac{1}{5}\right)=\frac{46}{15}.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设区域 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid0\leqslant x\leqslant\pi,0\leqslant y\leqslant\pi\right\} $，计算积分 $ \iint_{D}\left|\cos(x+y)\right|dxdy $。
explanationMarkdown:
方法1：用直线 $ y=\frac{\pi}{2}-x $ 和 $ y=\frac{3}{2}\pi-x $ 将 $ D $ 分割为 $ D_{1},D_{2},D_{3} $，则
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint\limits_{D}\left|\cos(x+y)\right|\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=\iint\limits_{D_{1}}\cos(x+y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y-\iint\limits_{D_{2}}\cos(x+y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint\limits_{D_{3}}\cos(x+y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}-x}\cos(x+y)\mathrm{d}y-\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}x\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}-x}^{\pi} \cos(x+y)\mathrm{d}y-\\&\quad\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{\frac{3\pi}{2}-x}\cos(x+y)\mathrm{d}y+\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi}\mathrm{d}x\int_{\frac{3\pi}{2}-x}^{\pi} \cos(x+y)\mathrm{d}y\\&=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(1-\sin x)\mathrm{d}x+\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(1+\sin x)\mathrm{d}x+\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi}(1+\sin x)\mathrm{d}x+\\&\quad\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi}(1-\sin x)\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\pi.\end{aligned} 
$$
方法2：
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}\left|\cos(x+y)\right|\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=\int_{0}^{\pi}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{\pi}\left|\cos(x+y)\right|\mathrm{d}y\\&=\int_{0}^{\pi}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{\pi}\left|\cos y\right|\mathrm{d}y=2\pi.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D:0 \leqslant x \leqslant y \leqslant 2\pi $，则 $ I = \iint_{D} |\sin(x - y) | \, dx \, dy = $ ___。
explanationMarkdown:
积分区域 $ D $ 如图所示。为去掉绝对值符号，由 $ y = x + \pi $ 将 $ D $ 划分为 $ D_{1} $ 与 $ D_{2} $，其中 $ D_{1}: -\pi\leqslant x-y\leqslant0 $，$ D_{2}: -2\pi\leqslant x-y\leqslant-\pi $。
$$
 \begin{aligned}I&=\iint_{D}\mid\sin(x-y)\mid\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&=\iint_{D_{1}}[-\sin(x-y)]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint_{D_{2}}\sin(x-y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&=\int_{0}^{\pi}\mathrm{d}y\int_{0}^{y}[-\sin(x-y)]\mathrm{d}x+\int_{\pi}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}y\int_{y-\pi}^{y}[-\sin(x-y)]\mathrm{d}x+\int_{\pi}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}y\int_{0}^{y-\pi}\sin(x-y)\mathrm{d}x\\&=4\pi.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant4\right\} $，计算 $ I=\iint_{D}\left|2x-x^{2}-y^{2}\right|\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y $。
explanationMarkdown:
记 $ f(x,y)=2x-x^{2}-y^{2}=1-(x-1)^{2}-y^{2} $。由 $ (x-1)^{2}+y^{2}=1 $ 将 $ D $ 分成 $ D_{1} $ 与 $ D_{2} $ 两部分，其中 $ D_{1}=\left\{(x,y)\mid(x-1)^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant1\right\} $，$ D_{2}=D-D_{1} $。
$$
 \begin{aligned}I&=\iint\limits_{D}\mid f(x,y)\mid\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&=\iint\limits_{D_{1}}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y-\iint\limits_{D_{2}}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&=2\iint\limits_{D_{1}}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y-\iint\limits_{D}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&\xlongequal{ 记 }I_{1}-I_{2},\end{aligned} 
$$
其中
$$
 \begin{aligned}I_{1}&=2\iint_{D_{1}}[1-(x-1)^{2}-y^{2}]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&\xlongequal{x-1=r\cos\theta,\,y=r\sin\theta}2\int_{0}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{1}(1-r^{2})r\mathrm{d}r\\&=4\pi\int_{0}^{1}(r-r^{3})\mathrm{d}r=\pi.\\I_{2}&=\iint_{D}[1-(x-1)^{2}-y^{2}]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint_{D}(2x-x^{2}-y^{2})\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y.\end{aligned} 
$$
由于 $ D $ 关于 $ y $ 轴对称，$ 2x $ 是奇函数，故 $ \iint_{D}2x\,dx\,dy = 0 $。所以，
$$
 I_{2}=0-\iint_{D}(x^{2}+y^{2})\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=-\int_{0}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2}r^{2}\bullet r\mathrm{d}r=-8\pi, 
$$
于是 $ I = I_{1} - I_{2} = \pi - (-8\pi) = 9\pi. $

contentMarkdown: 计算二重积分 $ \iint_{D}|x-|y||d\sigma $，其中 $ D=\left\{(x,y)|x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant2x,x\leqslant1\right\} $。
explanationMarkdown:
积分区域 $ D $ 关于 $ x $ 轴对称，记 $ D_{1} $ 为 $ D $ 在 $ x $ 轴上方的部分。用直线 $ y = x $ 将 $ D_{1} $ 分割为 $ D_{11} $ 与 $ D_{12} $ 两部分，如图所示。则
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}\left|x-|y|\right| d\sigma &=2\iint_{D_{1}}\left|x-y\right|d\sigma\\&=2\iint_{D_{11}}(x-y)d\sigma-2\iint_{D_{12}}(x-y)d\sigma\\&=2\int_{0}^{1}d x\int_{0}^{x}(x-y)d y-2\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}d\theta\int_{0}^{2\cos\theta}r^{2}(\cos\theta-\sin\theta)d r\\&=\int_{0}^{1}x^{2}d x-\frac{16}{3}\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\cos^{3}\theta(\cos\theta-\sin\theta)d\theta\\&=\frac{1}{3}-\frac{4}{3}\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\left(\frac{3}{2}+2\cos2\theta+\frac{1}{2}\cos4\theta\right)d\theta-\frac{16}{3}\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\cos^{3}\theta d(\cos\theta)\\&=\frac{1}{3}-\frac{4}{3}\left(\frac{3}{2}\theta+\sin2\theta+\frac{1}{8}\sin4\theta\right)\bigg|_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}-\frac{4}{3}\left(\cos^{4}\theta\right)\bigg|_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\\&=\frac{1}{3}-\frac{4}{3}\left(\frac{3\pi}{8}-1\right)+\frac{1}{3}=2-\frac{\pi}{2}.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 计算二重积分 $ \iint_{D}\left|x^{2}+y^{2}-\sqrt{2}(x+y)\right|\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y $，其中 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant4\right\} $。
explanationMarkdown:
用曲线 $ \left(x-\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)^{2}+\left(y-\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)^{2}=1 $ 将 $D$ 划分为 $D_{1},D_{2}$ 两部分，如图所示，则有
$$
 \begin{aligned}&\iint_{D}\left|x^{2}+y^{2}-\sqrt{2}(x+y)\right|\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\=&-\iint_{\overline{D}_{1}}\left[x^{2}+y^{2}-\sqrt{2}(x+y)\right]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint_{\overline{D}_{2}}\left[x^{2}+y^{2}-\sqrt{2}(x+y)\right]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\=&-\iint_{\overline{D}_{1}}\left[x^{2}+y^{2}-\sqrt{2}(x+y)\right]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint_{D-D_{1}}\left[x^{2}+y^{2}-\sqrt{2}(x+y)\right]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\=&-2\iint_{\overline{D}_{1}}\left[x^{2}+y^{2}-\sqrt{2}(x+y)\right]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint_{\overline{D}}\left[x^{2}+y^{2}-\sqrt{2}(x+y)\right]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\=&-4\int_{-\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)}\left[r^{3}-\sqrt{2}r^{2}(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)\right]\mathrm{d}r+\iint_{\overline{D}}(x^{2}+y^{2})\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\=&\frac{4}{3}\int_{-\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)^{4}\mathrm{d}\theta+\int_{0}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2}r^{3}\mathrm{d}r=\frac{16}{3}\int_{-\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin^{4}\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)\mathrm{d}\theta+8\pi\\&\xlongequal{\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}=t}\frac{16}{3}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin^{4}t\mathrm{d}t+8\pi=\frac{16}{3}\cdot\frac{3}{4}\cdot\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{\pi}{2}+8\pi=9\pi.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D=\{(x,y)|0\leqslant x\leqslant2,0\leqslant y\leqslant2\} $，计算 $ \iint_{D}|xy-1|\,\mathrm{d}\sigma $。
explanationMarkdown:
作出区域 $D$ 如图所示。在 $D$ 中作曲线 $ y=\frac{1}{x} $ 及直线 $ x=\frac{1}{2} $，将 $D$ 分成 3 块 $ D_{1},D_{2} $ 及 $ D_{3} $（见图）。
$$
 \mid xy-1\mid=\left\{\begin{aligned}&1-xy,&(x,y)\in D_{1},\\ &1-xy,&(x,y)\in D_{2},\\ &xy-1,&(x,y)\in D_{3}.\end{aligned}\right. 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint\limits_{D}\mid xy-1\mid\mathrm{d}\sigma=&\iint\limits_{D_{1}}(1-xy)\mathrm{d}\sigma+\iint\limits_{D_{2}}(1-xy)\mathrm{d}\sigma+\iint\limits_{D_{3}}(xy-1)\mathrm{d}\sigma\\=&\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{2}(1-xy)\mathrm{d}y+\int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{2}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{x}}(1-xy)\mathrm{d}y+\int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{2}\mathrm{d}x\int_{\frac{1}{x}}^{2}(xy-1)\mathrm{d}y\\=&\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}}(2-2x)\mathrm{d}x+\int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{2}\frac{1}{2x}\mathrm{d}x+\int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{2}\left(2x-2+\frac{1}{2x}\right)\mathrm{d}x=\frac{3}{2}+2\ln2.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid0\leqslant x\leqslant1,0\leqslant y\leqslant2\mathrm{e}\right\} $，计算二重积分 $ \iint_{D}x\left|y-\mathrm{e}^{x}\right|\mathrm{d}\sigma $。
explanationMarkdown:
如图所示，将 $D$ 分成 $ D_{1} \cup D_{2} $，$ D_{1} $ 与 $ D_{2} $ 除边界之外无公共部分。
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}x\mid y-\mathrm{e}^{x}\mid\mathrm{d}\sigma=&\iint_{D_{1}}x\mid y-\mathrm{e}^{x}\mid\mathrm{d}\sigma+\iint_{D_{2}}x\mid y-\mathrm{e}^{x}\mid\mathrm{d}\sigma\\=&\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{d}x\int_{e^{x}}^{2e}x(y-\mathrm{e}^{x})\mathrm{d}y+\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{e^{x}}x(\mathrm{e}^{x}-y)\mathrm{d}y\\=&\int_{0}^{1}\left(\frac{xy^{2}}{2}-yx\mathrm{e}^{x}\right)\left|\frac{2e}{e^{x}}\mathrm{d}x+\int_{0}^{1}\left(yx\mathrm{e}^{x}-\frac{xy^{2}}{2}\right)\right|_{0}^{e^{x}}\mathrm{d}x\\=&\int_{0}^{1}\left(2\mathrm{e}^{x}x-2\mathrm{e}x\mathrm{e}^{x}+\frac{1}{2}x\mathrm{e}^{2x}\right)\mathrm{d}x+\int_{0}^{1}\frac{x}{2}\mathrm{e}^{2x}\mathrm{d}x\\=&\frac{5}{4}\mathrm{e}^{2}-2\mathrm{e}+\frac{1}{4}.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant\sqrt{2},x\geqslant0,y\geqslant0\right\},[1+x^{2}+y^{2}] $ 表示不超过 $ 1+x^{2}+y^{2} $ 的最大整数，计算二重积分 $ \iint\limits_{D}xy[1+x^{2}+y^{2}]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y $.
explanationMarkdown:
作极坐标变换 $x=r\cos\theta,\ y=r\sin\theta$，则
$$
0\leqslant\theta\leqslant\frac{\pi}{2},\qquad 0\leqslant r\leqslant\sqrt[4]{2}.
$$
由于 $[1+x^2+y^2]=[1+r^2]$，故当 $0\leqslant r\lt1$ 时取值为 $1$，当 $1\leqslant r\leqslant\sqrt[4]{2}$ 时取值为 $2$。又
$$
xy\,\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=r^3\cos\theta\sin\theta\,\mathrm{d}r\mathrm{d}\theta,
$$
所以
$$
\begin{aligned}
I&=\int_0^{\pi/2}\cos\theta\sin\theta\,\mathrm{d}\theta
\left(\int_0^1 r^3\,\mathrm{d}r+2\int_1^{\sqrt[4]{2}}r^3\,\mathrm{d}r\right)\\
&=\frac12\left(\frac14+\frac12\right)=\frac38.
\end{aligned}
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D:0 \leqslant x \leqslant 2, 0 \leqslant y \leqslant 2 $，计算 $ I = \iint_{D} [1 + x + y] \, dx \, dy $，其中 $ [1 + x + y] $ 表示不超过 $ 1 + x + y $ 的最大整数。
explanationMarkdown:
如图 5-22 所示，直线 $ x + y = i (i = 1, 2, 3, 4) $ 将 D 分为 4 个区域 $ D_{k} (k = 1, 2, 3, 4) $，则 $ \left[1+x+y\right]=k\left(k=1,2,3,4\right) $，故 
$$
 \begin{aligned} I=&\iint_{D}[1+x+y]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\=&\iint_{D_{1}}1\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint_{D_{2}}2\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint_{D_{3}}3\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint_{D_{4}}4\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=10.\\ \end{aligned} 
$$
 注：$\iint_{D}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y$ 表示 D 的面积。

contentMarkdown:
设 $D$ 为第一象限内由圆
$$
x^2+y^2=1,\qquad x^2+y^2=9
$$
以及直线
$$
y=\frac{\sqrt3}{3}x,\qquad y=\sqrt3x
$$
围成的扇形环域。记 $[\sqrt{x^2+y^2}]$ 为不超过 $\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$ 的最大整数，计算
$$
\iint_D\frac{y}{x}[\sqrt{x^2+y^2}]\,dx\,dy.
$$
explanationMarkdown:
在第一象限内，两条直线分别对应
$$
\theta=\frac{\pi}{6},\qquad \theta=\frac{\pi}{3},
$$
两个圆分别对应 $r=1$ 和 $r=3$。因此
$$
D=\left\{(r,\theta)\middle|1\le r\le3,
\ \frac{\pi}{6}\le\theta\le\frac{\pi}{3}\right\}.
$$
在极坐标下，
$$
\frac yx=\tan\theta,\qquad dx\,dy=r\,dr\,d\theta.
$$
除去不影响积分值的圆周边界，当 $1\le r<2$ 时 $[r]=1$；当 $2\le r<3$ 时 $[r]=2$。所以
$$
\begin{aligned}
I
&=\int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/3}\tan\theta\,d\theta
\left(\int_1^2r\,dr+2\int_2^3r\,dr\right)\\
&=\left[-\ln(\cos\theta)\right]_{\pi/6}^{\pi/3}
\left(\frac32+5\right)\\
&=\ln\sqrt3\cdot\frac{13}{2}\\
&=\frac{13}{2}\ln\sqrt3
=\frac{13}{4}\ln3.
\end{aligned}
$$
本题的 $D$ 已明确限定为第一象限内的扇形环域，因此不需要再乘 $2$。若把第一、第三象限的两个对称区域同时作为积分区域，积分值才应为上述结果的两倍。

contentMarkdown: 计算二次积分 $ I=\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}\min\{x,y\}e^{-(x^{2}+y^{2})}dx dy $
explanationMarkdown:
令 $D_1=\{(x,y):y\lt x\}$。由交换 $x,y$ 的对称性，
$$
I=2\iint_{D_1}y e^{-(x^2+y^2)}\,dx\,dy.
$$
在极坐标中 $D_1$ 对应 $-\frac{3\pi}4\lt\theta\lt\frac\pi4$，故
$$
I=2\int_{-3\pi/4}^{\pi/4}\sin\theta\,d\theta\int_0^{+\infty}r^2e^{-r^2}\,dr=-2\sqrt2\cdot\frac{\sqrt\pi}{4}=-\frac{\sqrt{2\pi}}2.
$$

contentMarkdown: 计算 $ \iint_{D} \max\{xy,1\} \, dx \, dy $，其中 $ D = \{(x,y)|0 \leqslant x \leqslant 2, 0 \leqslant y \leqslant 2\} $
explanationMarkdown:
将正方形 $D=[0,2]\times[0,2]$ 按 $xy=1$ 分为两部分。$xy\leqslant1$ 的面积为
$$
1+\int_{1/2}^{2}\frac{1}{x}\,\mathrm{d}x=1+2\ln2.
$$
在 $xy\gt1$ 上积分 $xy$，得
$$
\int_{1/2}^{2}\int_{1/x}^{2}xy\,\mathrm{d}y\mathrm{d}x=\int_{1/2}^{2}\left(2x-\frac{1}{2x}\right)\mathrm{d}x=\frac{15}{4}-\ln2.
$$
因此原积分为 $1+2\ln2+\frac{15}{4}-\ln2=\frac{19}{4}+\ln2$。

contentMarkdown: 计算二重积分 $ \iint_{D}\sin x\sin y\max\left\{x,y\right\}dxdy $，其中 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid0\leq x\leq\pi,0\leq y\leq\pi\right\} $
explanationMarkdown:
令 $ D_{1}=\{(x,y) \in D \mid x \ge y\} $，$ D_{2}=\{(x,y) \in D \mid x \le y\} $，由对称性得 
$$
 \begin{aligned}I&=\iint_{D_{1}}x\sin x\sin y\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint_{D_{2}}y\sin x\sin y\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&=\int_{0}^{\pi}x\sin x\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{x}\sin y\mathrm{d}y+\int_{0}^{\pi}y\sin y\mathrm{d}y\int_{0}^{y}\sin x\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int_{0}^{\pi}x\sin x\left(1-\cos x\right)\mathrm{d}x+\int_{0}^{\pi}y\sin y\left(1-\cos y\right)\mathrm{d}y\\&=2\int_{0}^{\pi}x\sin x\left(1-\cos x\right)\mathrm{d}x\\&=-2\int_{0}^{\pi}x\mathrm{d}\cos x+\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{\pi}x\mathrm{d}\cos2x\\&=-2\left(x\cos x\right)\Big|_{0}^{\pi}+\int_{0}^{\pi}\cos x\mathrm{d}x+\frac{1}{2}\left(x\cos2x\right)\Big|_{0}^{\pi}-\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{\pi}\cos2x\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\pi+\frac{\pi}{2}=\frac{5}{2}\pi\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown:
设
$$
D=\{(x,y)\mid 0\le x\le1,\ 0\le y\le1\},
$$
计算
$$
I=\iint_D\max\{2x-x^2,(1-y)^2\}\,dx\,dy.
$$
explanationMarkdown:
令
$$
u=1-x,\qquad v=1-y.
$$
则 $0\le u\le1$，$0\le v\le1$，且
$$
2x-x^2=1-u^2,\qquad (1-y)^2=v^2.
$$
两部分相等时，
$$
1-u^2=v^2,
$$
即
$$
u^2+v^2=1.
$$
因此，在第一象限的四分之一单位圆盘
$$
D_1=\{(u,v)\mid u\ge0,\ v\ge0,\ u^2+v^2\le1\}
$$
内，有 $1-u^2\ge v^2$；在单位正方形内的其余部分，有 $1-u^2<v^2$。

为了简化计算，先在整个单位正方形上积分 $v^2$，再在 $D_1$ 内补上两者之差：
$$
I=\iint_{[0,1]^2}v^2\,du\,dv
+\iint_{D_1}(1-u^2-v^2)\,du\,dv.
$$
第一项为
$$
\iint_{[0,1]^2}v^2\,du\,dv
=\int_0^1\int_0^1v^2\,du\,dv
=\frac13.
$$
第二项在 $D_1$ 上使用极坐标 $u=r\cos\theta$，$v=r\sin\theta$：
$$
\begin{aligned}
\iint_{D_1}(1-u^2-v^2)\,du\,dv
&=\int_0^{\pi/2}\int_0^1(1-r^2)r\,dr\,d\theta\\
&=\frac{\pi}{2}\left[\frac{r^2}{2}-\frac{r^4}{4}\right]_0^1\\
&=\frac{\pi}{8}.
\end{aligned}
$$
所以
$$
I=\frac13+\frac{\pi}{8}=\frac{8+3\pi}{24}.
$$
两种答案形式完全等价。

contentMarkdown: 设 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid0\leqslant x\leqslant\sqrt{\pi},0\leqslant y\leqslant\sqrt{\pi}\right\} $，计算二重积分 $ \iint_{D}\sin(\max\{x^{2},y^{2}\})\mathrm{d}\sigma $.
explanationMarkdown:
D是一矩形区域，如图所示。
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}\sin(\max\{x^{2},y^{2}\})\mathrm{d}\sigma&=\iint_{D_{1}}\sin x^{2}\mathrm{d}\sigma+\iint_{D_{2}}\sin y^{2}\mathrm{d}\sigma\\&=2\iint_{D_{1}}\sin x^{2}\mathrm{d}\sigma\\&=2\int_{0}^{\sqrt{\pi}}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{x}\sin x^{2}\mathrm{d}y\\&=2\int_{0}^{\sqrt{\pi}}x\sin x^{2}\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int_{0}^{\sqrt{\pi}}\sin x^{2}\mathrm{d}(x^{2})\\&=-\cos x^{2}\bigg|_{0}^{\sqrt{\pi}}\\&=-\left(-1-1\right)=2.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设区域D为 $ x^2 + y^2 \leqslant 2x $ 与 $ |y| \leqslant \sqrt{3}x $ 的重合部分，计算 $ \iint\limits_{D}\max\left\{2-\left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right),x^{2}+y^{2}\right\}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y. $
explanationMarkdown:
由题意可知积分区域 $ D = D_{1} + D_{2} $ 如图所示。
又
$$
 \max\{2-(x^{2}+y^{2}),x^{2}+y^{2}\}=\left\{\begin{aligned}&2-(x^{2}+y^{2}),&x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant1,\\ &x^{2}+y^{2},&x^{2}+y^{2}\gt 1.\end{aligned}\right. 
$$
 
所以
$$
 \begin{aligned}&\iint_{D}\max\{2-(x^{2}+y^{2}),x^{2}+y^{2}\}\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\=&\iint_{D_{1}}\left[2-(x^{2}+y^{2})\right]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint_{D_{2}}(x^{2}+y^{2})\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\=&2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{3}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{1}r\cdot(2-r^{2})\mathrm{d}r+2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{3}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{1}^{2\cos\theta}r^{2}\cdot r\mathrm{d}r\\=&\frac{2\pi}{3}\cdot\left(r^{2}-\frac{1}{4}r^{4}\right)\bigg|_{0}^{1}+2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{3}}\left(4\cos^{4}\theta-\frac{1}{4}\right)\mathrm{d}\theta\\=&\frac{2\pi}{3}\cdot\frac{3}{4}+8\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{3}}\cos^{4}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta-\frac{\pi}{6}\\=&\frac{\pi}{2}+\pi+\frac{7\sqrt{3}}{8}-\frac{\pi}{6}\\=&\frac{7\sqrt{3}}{8}+\frac{4}{3}\pi.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 设 $ f(x,y)=\max\left\{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}},1\right\},D=\left\{(x,y)\mid |x|\leqslant y\leqslant1\right\}. $ 求 $ \iint\limits_{D}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}\sigma. $
explanationMarkdown:
如图所示，将D分成三块，中间一块记为 $ D_{3} $，左、右两块分别记为 $ D_{1} $ 与 $ D_{2} $，则
$$
 \begin{aligned}f(x,y)&=\max\{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}},1\}\\&=\begin{cases}\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}},&(x,y)\in D_{1}\bigcup D_{2},\\1,&(x,y)\in D_{3}.\end{cases}\end{aligned} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}\sigma&=\iint_{D_{1}\cup D_{2}}\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}\mathrm{d}\sigma+\iint_{D_{3}}\mathrm{d}\sigma\\&=\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{3\pi}{4}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{1}^{\frac{1}{\sin\theta}}r^{2}\mathrm{d}r+\frac{\pi}{4}\\&=\frac{1}{3}\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{3\pi}{4}}(\csc^{3}\theta-1)\mathrm{d}\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\\&=\frac{1}{3}\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{3\pi}{4}}\csc^{3}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta+\frac{\pi}{12}.\end{aligned} 
$$
 
而
$$
 \begin{aligned}\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{3\pi}{4}}\csc^{3}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta=&\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{3\pi}{4}}\csc\theta\csc^{2}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta\\=&-\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{3\pi}{4}}\csc\theta\mathrm{d}(\cot\theta)=-\left.\left(\csc\theta\cot\theta\right|_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{3\pi}{4}}+\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{3\pi}{4}}\cot^{2}\theta\csc\theta\mathrm{d}\theta\right)\\=&-\left[-\sqrt{2}-\sqrt{2}+\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{3\pi}{4}}(\csc^{2}\theta-1)\csc\theta\mathrm{d}\theta\right],\end{aligned} 
$$
 
所以
$$
 \begin{aligned}\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{3\pi}{4}}\csc^{3}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta&=\sqrt{2}+\frac{1}{2}\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{3\pi}{4}}\csc\theta\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=\sqrt{2}+\frac{1}{2}(\ln|\csc\theta-\cot\theta|)\bigg|_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{3\pi}{4}}\\&=\sqrt{2}+\frac{1}{2}\left[\ln(\sqrt{2}+1)-\ln(\sqrt{2}-1)\right]\\&=\sqrt{2}+\ln(\sqrt{2}+1).\end{aligned} 
$$
 
故原式 $ =\frac{\sqrt{2}}{3}+\frac{1}{3}\ln(\sqrt{2}+1)+\frac{\pi}{12}. $

contentMarkdown: 计算 $ \iint_{D} \max\{x, y\} d\sigma $，其中 D 是 $ x^{2} + y^{2} \leqslant 2x $ 与 $ x^{2} + y^{2} \leqslant 2y $ 重合的部分.
explanationMarkdown:
积分区域 D 如图所示，则
$$
 \begin{aligned} 原式 &=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2\sin\theta}r\cos\theta\cdot r\mathrm{d}r+\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2\cos\theta}r\sin\theta\cdot r\mathrm{d}r\\&=\frac{8}{3}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\cos\theta\sin^{3}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta+\frac{8}{3}\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sin\theta\cos^{3}\theta\mathrm{d}\theta\\&=\frac{8}{3}\left(\left.\frac{\sin^{4}\theta}{4}\right|_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}-\left.\frac{\cos^{4}\theta}{4}\right|_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\right)\\&=\frac{8}{3}\left(\frac{1}{16}+\frac{1}{16}\right)=\frac{1}{3}.\end{aligned} 
$$

contentMarkdown: 交换积分次序 $ \int_{-\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2\cos\theta}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)r\mathrm{d}r= $ ___.
explanationMarkdown:
原积分区域为
$$
D=\left\{(r,\theta):-\frac{\pi}{4}\leqslant\theta\leqslant\frac{\pi}{2},\ 0\leqslant r\leqslant2\cos\theta\right\}.
$$
交换次序时固定 $r$。由 $r\leqslant2\cos\theta$ 得
$$
-\arccos\frac{r}{2}\leqslant\theta\leqslant\arccos\frac{r}{2}.
$$
因此下界为 $\max\left\{-\frac{\pi}{4},-\arccos\frac{r}{2}\right\}$。当 $0\leqslant r\leqslant\sqrt2$ 时，下界为 $-\dfrac{\pi}{4}$；当 $\sqrt2\leqslant r\leqslant2$ 时，下界为 $-\arccos\dfrac{r}{2}$。故
$$
\int_{-\pi/4}^{\pi/2}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_0^{2\cos\theta}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)r\,\mathrm{d}r
=\int_0^{\sqrt2}\mathrm{d}r\int_{-\pi/4}^{\arccos(r/2)} f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)r\,\mathrm{d}\theta+\int_{\sqrt2}^{2}\mathrm{d}r\int_{-\arccos(r/2)}^{\arccos(r/2)} f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)r\,\mathrm{d}\theta.
$$

contentMarkdown: 交换 $ I = \int_{-\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} d\theta \int_{0}^{a \cos \theta} f(r, \theta) dr $ 的积分次序 ___.
explanationMarkdown:
原积分区域为
$$
D=\left\{(r,\theta):-\frac{\pi}{4}\leqslant\theta\leqslant\frac{\pi}{2},\ 0\leqslant r\leqslant a\cos\theta\right\}.
$$
对固定的 $r$，条件 $r\leqslant a\cos\theta$ 等价于
$$
-\arccos\frac{r}{a}\leqslant\theta\leqslant\arccos\frac{r}{a}.
$$
因此 $\theta$ 的下界应为 $\max\left\{-\frac{\pi}{4},-\arccos\frac{r}{a}\right\}$。当 $0\leqslant r\leqslant\dfrac{a}{\sqrt2}$ 时，下界仍为 $-\dfrac{\pi}{4}$；当 $\dfrac{a}{\sqrt2}\leqslant r\leqslant a$ 时，下界变为 $-\arccos\dfrac{r}{a}$。故交换次序为
$$
I=\int_0^{a/\sqrt2}\mathrm{d}r\int_{-\pi/4}^{\arccos(r/a)}f(r,\theta)\,\mathrm{d}\theta+\int_{a/\sqrt2}^{a}\mathrm{d}r\int_{-\arccos(r/a)}^{\arccos(r/a)}f(r,\theta)\,\mathrm{d}\theta.
$$

contentMarkdown: 交换积分顺序 $ I=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{a\sqrt{\sin2\theta}}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)r\mathrm{d}r(a\gt0) $ 为
explanationMarkdown: 解 极坐标下交换积分顺序可视 $ \theta $ 为 x 轴，r 为 y 轴，用直角坐标处理（包括画图和确定积分限）。依题意，已知积分区域如图 5-32 所示。当 $ 0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant \frac{\pi}{4} $ 时， $ r = a\sqrt{\sin 2\theta} $ 的反函数为 $ \theta=\frac{1}{2}\arcsin\frac{r^{2}}{a^{2}} $；当 $ \frac{\pi}{4}\lt \theta\leqslant\frac{\pi}{2} $时， $ r=a\sqrt{\sin2\theta} $的反函数为 $ \theta=\frac{\pi}{2}-\frac{1}{2}\arcsin\frac{r^{2}}{a^{2}} $，故 $ I=\int_{0}^{a}\mathrm{d}r\int_{\frac{1}{2}\arcsin\frac{r^{2}}{a^{2}}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}-\frac{1}{2}\arcsin\frac{r^{2}}{a^{2}}}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)r\mathrm{d}\theta. $

contentMarkdown:
累次积分 $ \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} d\theta \int_{0}^{\cos\theta} f(r\cos\theta, r\sin\theta) r dr $ 可以写成（）

A. $ \int_{0}^{1}dy\int_{0}^{\sqrt{y-y^{2}}}f(x,y)dx $
B. $ \int_{0}^{1}dy\int_{0}^{\sqrt{1-y^{2}}}f(x,y)dx $
C. $ \int_{0}^{1}dx\int_{0}^{1}f(x,y)dy $
D. $ \int_{0}^{1}dx\int_{0}^{\sqrt{x-x^{2}}}f(x,y)dy $
explanationMarkdown: 原积分对应极坐标区域 $0\leqslant\theta\leqslant\frac{\pi}{2},\ 0\leqslant r\leqslant\cos\theta$，即第一象限内圆 $x^{2}+y^{2}=x$ 的内部。写成直角坐标为 $0\leqslant x\leqslant1,\ 0\leqslant y\leqslant\sqrt{x-x^{2}}$，故选 D。

contentMarkdown: 交换积分次序： $ \int_{0}^{\frac{1}{4}}dy\int_{y}^{\sqrt{y}}f(x,y)dx+\int_{\frac{1}{4}}^{\frac{1}{2}}dy\int_{y}^{\frac{1}{2}}f(x,y)dx= $ ___.
explanationMarkdown:
两部分区域合并后可写成
$$
D=\{(x,y):0\le x\le\tfrac12,\ x^2\le y\le x\}.
$$
因此交换积分次序后为
$$
\int_0^{1/2}dx\int_{x^2}^{x}f(x,y)\,dy.
$$

contentMarkdown:
设 $ f(x,y) $ 为连续函数，则 $ \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{1}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)r\mathrm{d}r $ 等于（）

A. $ \int_{0}^{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}}\mathrm{d}x\int_{x}^{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}y $
B. $ \int_{0}^{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}y $
C. $ \int_{0}^{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}}\mathrm{d}y\int_{y}^{\sqrt{1-y^{2}}}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x $
D. $ \int_{0}^{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}}\mathrm{d}y\int_{0}^{\sqrt{1-y^{2}}}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x $
explanationMarkdown: 原积分区域为单位圆第一象限中 $0\leqslant\theta\leqslant\frac{\pi}{4}$ 的部分，即 $0\leqslant y\leqslant x$ 且 $x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant1$。若先对 $x$ 积分，则 $0\leqslant y\leqslant\frac{\sqrt2}{2}$，$y\leqslant x\leqslant\sqrt{1-y^{2}}$，故选 C。

contentMarkdown:
将二重积分 $ I=\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2\sin\theta}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)r\mathrm{d}r $ 化为直角坐标系下的二次积分，则 $ I=(\quad) $.

A. $ \int_{0}^{1}dx\int_{1-\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}^{x}f(x,y)dy $
B. $ \int_{0}^{1}dx\int_{x}^{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}f(x,y)dy $
C. $\int_0^1dy\int_0^y f(x,y)dx+\int_1^2dy\int_0^{\sqrt{2y-y^2}}f(x,y)dx$
D. $ \int_{0}^{1}dy\int_{y}^{\sqrt{2y-y^{2}}}f(x,y)dx $
explanationMarkdown: 区域由 $\frac\pi4\le\theta\le\frac\pi2,\ 0\le r\le2\sin\theta$ 给出，即圆 $x^2+(y-1)^2\le1$ 内且 $y\ge x,\ x\ge0$ 的部分。按 $y$ 分段：当 $0\le y\le1$ 时，$0\le x\le y$；当 $1\le y\le2$ 时，$0\le x\le\sqrt{2y-y^2}$。故选 C。

contentMarkdown:
设 $D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leq2x,x^{2}+y^{2}\leq2y\right\}$，函数 $f(x,y)$ 在 $D$ 上连续，则 $\iint_{D}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=$

A. $\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2\cos\theta}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)r\mathrm{d}r+\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2\sin\theta}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)r\mathrm{d}r$
B. $\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2\sin\theta}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)r\mathrm{d}r+\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2\cos\theta}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)r\mathrm{d}r$
C. $2\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{d}x\int_{1-\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}^{x}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}y$
D. $2\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{d}x\int_{x}^{\sqrt{2x-x^{2}}}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}y$
explanationMarkdown: 在极坐标下，两圆分别给出 $r\le2\cos\theta$ 与 $r\le2\sin\theta$。当 $0\le\theta\le\frac{\pi}{4}$ 时取上界 $2\sin\theta$；当 $\frac{\pi}{4}\le\theta\le\frac{\pi}{2}$ 时取上界 $2\cos\theta$，故选 B。

contentMarkdown:
设 $D:x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant x$，则 $\iint_{D}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=(\quad)$.

A. $\int_{0}^{\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{\cos\theta}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)r\mathrm{d}r$
B. $\int_{0}^{\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{\sin\theta}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)r\mathrm{d}r$
C. $\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{\cos\theta}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)r\mathrm{d}r$
D. $\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{\sin\theta}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)r\mathrm{d}r$
explanationMarkdown: 由 $x^2+y^2\le x$，令 $x=r\cos\theta,\ y=r\sin\theta$，得 $r^2\le r\cos\theta$。区域内 $r\ge0$，故 $0\le r\le\cos\theta$，并要求 $\cos\theta\ge0$，即 $-\frac\pi2\le\theta\le\frac\pi2$。因此选 C。

contentMarkdown:
设函数 $ f(x,y) $ 连续，则二次积分 $ \int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} \mathrm{d}x \int_{\sin x}^{1} f(x,y) \mathrm{d}y $ 等于（）.

A. $ \int_{0}^{1}dy\int_{\pi+\arcsin y}^{\pi}f(x,y)dx $
B. $ \int_{0}^{1}dy\int_{\pi-\arcsin y}^{\pi}f(x,y)dx $
C. $ \int_{0}^{1}dy\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi+\arcsin y}f(x,y)dx $
D. $ \int_{0}^{1}dy\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi-\arcsin y}f(x,y)dx $
explanationMarkdown: 当 $ x \in \left[\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\right] $ 时， $ \pi - x \in \left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right] $。由 $ y=\sin x=\sin(\pi-x) $，得 $ \pi-x=\arcsin y $，即 $ x=\pi-\arcsin y $。从而 D 的 Y 型区域为 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid\pi-\arcsin y\leqslant x\leqslant\pi,0\leqslant y\leqslant1\right\} $。故 $ \int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi}\mathrm{d}x\int_{\sin x}^{1}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}y=\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{d}y\int_{\pi-\arcsin y}^{\pi}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x $，应选(B)。

contentMarkdown:
设 $ f(x,y) $ 是连续函数，则 $ \int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}dx\int_{\sin x}^{1}f(x,y)dy= $ ___.

A. $ \int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{1}dy\int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\arcsin y}f(x,y)dx $
B. $ \int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{1}dy\int_{\arcsin y}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}f(x,y)dx $
C. $ \int_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}}dy\int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\arcsin y}f(x,y)dx $
D. $ \int_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}}dy\int_{\arcsin y}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}f(x,y)dx $
explanationMarkdown:
积分区域为 
$$
\frac{\pi}{6}\le x\le \frac{\pi}{2},\qquad \sin x\le y\le1.
$$
 因为 $\sin x$ 在 $\left[\frac{\pi}{6},\frac{\pi}{2}\right]$ 上单调递增，换序后有 
$$
\frac12\le y\le1,\qquad \frac{\pi}{6}\le x\le\arcsin y.
$$
 故原积分等于 
$$
\int_{\frac12}^{1}dy\int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\arcsin y}f(x,y)\,dx,
$$

contentMarkdown: 交换积分次序 $ \int_{0}^{1} \mathrm{d}y \int_{\sqrt{y}}^{\sqrt{2-y^{2}}} f(x,y) \mathrm{d}x = $ ___.
explanationMarkdown: 积分区域 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid\sqrt{y}\leqslant x\leqslant\sqrt{2-y^{2}},0\leqslant y\leqslant1\right\} $。将区域向 x 轴投影，令 $ D_{1}=\left\{(x,y)\mid0\leqslant x\leqslant1,0\leqslant y\leqslant x^{2}\right\}, $ $ D_{2}=\left\{(x,y)\mid1\leqslant x\leqslant\sqrt{2},0\leqslant y\leqslant\sqrt{2-x^{2}}\right\} $。则 $ \int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{d}y\int_{\sqrt{y}}^{\sqrt{2-y^{2}}}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x=\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{x^{2}}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}y+\int_{1}^{\sqrt{2}}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{\sqrt{2-x^{2}}}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}y. $
